Un periodista va a Maryland a conocer la historia de una mujer que teme comprometerse y ha dejado a muchos en el altar.
Una joven, con sueños de convertirse en compositora de éxito, presenta su trabajo en un bullicioso bar de Nueva York.
Un empresario contrata a una prostituta hermosa para que sea su acompañante durante una semana de negocios en Beverly Hills.
Abra tries to collect more HIV drugs from the pharmacist, while Elliot reprimands Joseph again. Sam asks to be Connie's birthing partner.
Ash and Tess work to discover why a mother and daughter are so at odds about how far the team should go to save the father's life while Jamie accidentally helps crack open a love triangle.
A mad gunman on the loose in Sun Hill gives Chandler problems with the local press. Meadows and DS McAllister arrest their prime suspect, but as they interview him, the gunman strikes again.
The Masoods turn on each other in the wake of Tam's revelations, but a bigger shock lies in store for Zainab when Yusef makes an unexpected confession.
Zainab vows to reunite her fractured family after the previous night's terrible events - but will Tam and Masood listen to her plea? Denise has a savage demand for Yusef.

Eileen is not happy when she finds out Joan is divorced with two children. At the same time, Terry Inglis begins searching for a new place to live, indicating changes in her living situation. Terry decides to move to the country.
Paul Robinson proposes to his partner, Terry Inglis, marking a significant milestone in their relationship.
A fancy new radio station arrives at Great Slaughter, but the host is mysteriously murdered amid the broadcast.
After a murder at the Kembleford charity treasure hunt, general suspicion falls upon a bereaved man who wants revenge. However, Father Brown is determined to prove the man's innocence.
While Lionel is content to live his life slowly, Jean feels she must keep working, irritating Judy and Sandy to no end.
Howard's failure to hypnotise Pearl prompts Foggy to demonstrate how he can influence people and lose friends.
Foggy is not at all surprised when he learns that he may be a member of the aristocracy, Compo concludes that a hat is way to Nora's heart, and Marina is looking for love with a taller man.
Following a day trip to the seaside, Compo becomes hooked on the trampoline in more ways than one.
Allie and Andi search for Andi's mum while Jack and Noah investigate a corpse, both teams uncovering unexpected secrets and revelations.

p.t: Das Universum - Eine Reise durch Raum und Zeit
p.d: Zwerggalaxien, Schwarze Löcher oder Wolken aus überhitztem Wasserstoffgas: Was ist die Ursache dafür, dass die Milchstraße stirbt und immer mehr Sterne erlöschen? Forscher und Wissenschaftler machen sich auf die Suche nach dem Ursprung des Phänomens und blicken dazu auf die 13,6 Milliarden Jahre lange Entwicklung der Galaxie zurück. Können die Erkenntnisse erste Hinweise darauf geben, wann und wie die Milchstraße ausgelöscht wird?

p.t: Das Universum - Eine Reise durch Raum und Zeit
p.d: Das Universum - eine katastrophale Vorstellung: Ein Asteroid trifft die Erde, Städte werden zerstört und riesige Tsunamis überfluten den Planeten. Was früher unter Wissenschaftlern als unvermeidlich galt, könnte heute mit neuster Technologie verhindert werden. Ein ausgeklügeltes Frühwarn- und Verteidigungssystem soll die Erde vor einem verheerenden Asteroideneinschlag bewahren. Doch kann die Erde bei einer drohenden Gefahr wirklich verteidigt werden?

p.t: Das Universum - Eine Reise durch Raum und Zeit
p.d: Das Universum - Vier Jahre lang sendete die Raumsonde Messenger nie zuvor gesehene Bilder vom Merkur. Der Planet ist der Sonne am nächsten und vereint zahlreiche Widersprüche. So konnte die NASA neben Vulkanismus und tektonischen Aktivitäten trotz der extrem hohen Temperaturen die Existenz von Eis auf dem Merkur nachweisen. Was hat es damit auf sich? Und warum denken Forscher, dass der Planet zu einer Gefahr für die Erde werden könnte?

p.t: Expedition X - Dem Unheimlichen auf der Spur
p.d: Josh Gates ist diesmal in Mexiko-Stadt unterwegs, wo es eine Geisterinsel geben soll. Der Geist eines ertrunkenen Mädchens soll in den schwimmenden Gärten von Xochimilco, das zugleich ein Labyrinth aus Kanälen ist, sein Unwesen treiben.

p.t: Expedition X - Dem Unheimlichen auf der Spur
p.d: Josh Gates und sein Team wollen in dieser Episode die Legende vom Mottenmann unter die Lupe nehmen, dessen skurriler Mythos in den USA schon seit den 1960er Jahren existiert. Die Nachforschungen beginnen in Point Pleasant, West Virginia.

p.t: Expedition X - Dem Unheimlichen auf der Spur
p.d: Jessica und Phil reisen nach Kambodscha auf den Spuren des furchterregenden Tek Tek. Laut den Einheimischen ist dies eine gefährliche Kreatur. Bei ihrer Suche nach dem urzeitlichen Menschenaffen stoßen sie im dichten Regenwald auch auf Angkor Wat.

p.t: Expedition X - Dem Unheimlichen auf der Spur
p.d: Phil und Jessica reisen nach Thailand, um mehr über eine gefährliche Sekte zu erfahren. Die Gruppe behauptet, seit mehreren Jahrzehnten mit Außerirdischen in Kontakt zu stehen und Geheimnisse über die Apokalypse zu kennen.

p.t: Expedition X - Dem Unheimlichen auf der Spur
p.d: Die Mammut-Höhle in Kentucky erstreckt sich über eine Länge von über 650 Kilometern und wurde einst als rituelle Grabstätte genutzt. Das Team untersucht das Höhlensystem, um mehr über die Höhlengeister der Unterwelt herauszufinden.

p.t: Expedition X - Dem Unheimlichen auf der Spur
p.d: Das Team nimmt mithilfe eines Hightech-Geräts einen UFO-Hotspot genauer unter die Lupe.

p.t: Expedition X - Dem Unheimlichen auf der Spur
p.d: Im Mittelpunkt steht eine geheimnisvolle verlassene Stadt, die sich tief im brasilianischen Amazonas befindet. Der Biologe Phil Torres und Jessica Chobot wollen die Stadt erforschen und stoßen dabei auf deren düstere Vergangenheit.

p.t: Expedition X - Dem Unheimlichen auf der Spur
p.d: Phil und Jessica sind am künstlich angelegten Lake Lanier. Er wird auch "See der Toten" genannt, weil er über 20 Friedhöfe verschlungen hat. Sie ermitteln in und um das Gewässer, um Gerüchten über Ertrinkungsfälle und Geisterbegegnungen nachzugehen.

p.t: Expedition X - Dem Unheimlichen auf der Spur
p.d: Jessica und Phil besuchen einen Viehzüchter, der auf seinem Gelände fünf tote Rinder entdeckt hat, denen offenbar mit chirurgischer Präzision Organe entnommen wurden. Dabei wurden aber weder Blut- noch Kampfspuren hinterlassen.

Bruce und John suchen auf dem Gelände des Oakbank Race Course nach alten Silbermünzen. Die Besitzer einer Brauerei haben dort im 19. Jahrhundert Pferderennen organisiert. Michelle und Andrew sind in einer Goldgräberregion unterwegs.

Colleen und Warren erkunden im Regenwald von New South Wales einen ehemaligen Binnenhafen, der eine bewegte Vergangenheit hat. Aber die Suche nach spannenden Objekten aus dem 19. Jahrhundert entwickelt sich zu einer schweißtreibenden Angelegenheit.

p.t: Expedition X - Dem Unheimlichen auf der Spur
p.d: Josh Gates, Heather Amaro und Phil Torres besuchen in dieser Folge das vielleicht am meisten heimgesuchte Gebäude Amerikas. Die im Jahr 1864 eröffnete Trans-Allegheny-Anstalt steht tief in der Wildnis von West Virginia wie ein Mahnmal.

The lives of 10 strangers intersect as a mutating fungus begins to spread through a small town, wiping out everyone that comes into contact with it.
An FBI agent (Brennan Elliott) must fake his own death to team with an assassin (Michael Dudikoff) and infiltrate a terrorist group.
Steven (Ryan Phillippe) and Shannon (Rachelle Lefevre) risk their lives to uncover the truth behind their newly adopted daughter's disappearance in a small town.
Rival gangs hire a British thug (Mick Rossi), who was imprisoned for eight years, to complete a hit in Los Angeles.

When the wife and daughter of Army drill sergeant John North (Brian Bosworth) are killed during an arms deal involving a crooked FBI agent named Karl Savak (Bruce Payne), John decides to take matters into his own hands, only to discover that the henchman responsible for their deaths has been put into witness protection. Now, John must enlist the help of a street-smart kid named Mikey (DeJuan Guy) to infiltrate the city's criminal underground and get his own form of revenge.
A criminal goes on the warpath after his heist money is stolen, and his father is murdered.

In this sci-fi/fantasy sequel, Connor MacLeod (Christopher Lambert) has become an elderly man after losing his immortality. Living in a bleak future where the world is protected from solar radiation by a massive shield, MacLeod regains his youth when he kills two assassins from his home planet. This results in an ongoing battle with the villainous and powerful Gen. Katana (Michael Ironside), but MacLeod receives help when the noble Juan Ramirez (Sean Connery) returns.
A fight promoter and his new client land in trouble with a loan shark.

Gary Faulkner (Nicolas Cage), an ex-con, unemployed handyman, and modern day Don Quixote receives a vision from God telling him to capture Osama bin Laden. Armed with only a single sword purchased from a home-shopping network, Gary travels to Pakistan to complete his mission. While on his quest, Gary encounters old friends back home in Colorado, new friends he makes in Pakistan, the enemies he makes at the CIA -- and even God and Osama themselves.

Inspired by the legendary Egyptian warrior, "The Scorpion King" is set 5000 years ago in the notorious city of Gomorrah, where an evil ruler is determined to lay waste to all the nomadic peoples of the desert. The few remaining tribes, never natural allies, have to unite or perish. Knowing their enemy relies on the visions of a sorcerer, they hire a skilled assassin, Mathayus, to eliminate the visionary.

Under cover of night, vampires engage in an age-old battle with their sworn enemies, the Lycans, a clan of violent werewolves. Selene, a vampire orphaned in the wake of a bloody Lycan attack, works for the vampire clan as a trained killer. When the Lycans take a mysterious interest in Michael Corvin, an exceptional mortal doctor, Selene struggles to save him from Lucian, a ruthless Lycan leader hell-bent on ending the vampire bloodline.

Greenberg, aka "Greeny," is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime "Mike & Mike" morning show.

p.t: Mujer, casos de la vida real
p.d: Esta serie conmovedora, que en el comienzo fue titulada solamente Casos de la Vida Real, ahora tiene añadido el sustantivo Mujer y como su título lo indica, realiza dos dramatizaciones por episodio de dos casos reales que le han sucedido a mujeres comunes. Estos casos son elegidos a través de miles de cartas enviadas por las televidentes a la programadora mexicana Televisa, la cual produce esta serie. Un equipo especializado selecciona los casos junto a la presentadora del programa, la gran actriz Silvia Pinal, los temas que se representan en el programa son temas de interés general que son censurados por la sociedad como: el incesto, la infidelidad, el aborto, la bigamia, entre otros. Al final se aconseja a las mujeres que viven situaciones similares el que pidan ayuda. Este programa de una hora también ha colaborado reuniendo hijos con sus madres o familiares que han estado alejados por muchos años.

Cada episodio de sesenta minutos en la serie "La rosa de Guadalupe", incluye la dramatización de un caso de personas comunes que experimentan un milagro verdadero realizado por la Virgen de Guadalupe, las historias relatadas en el programa son una fuente de inspiración y esperanza para las personas que estén atravesando por un problema, el misterio, el desconcierto y asombro son sentimientos comunes que se generan al ver este programa. El título de esta serie proviene de la leyenda que al pedir un milagro a la Virgen de Guadalupe, se coloca una rosa al frente de la imagen y se le reza.

Las vicisitudes del Chavo, un niño de 8 años que es huérfano y quien vive en un barril ubicado dentro de una vecindad, y que junto a Quico, la Chilindrina, Ñoño y la Popis experimentan una serie de enredos y graciosas confusiones.

Rubí es una hermosa joven universitaria que vive junto con su madre Doña Refugio y su hermana Cristina en una pobre vecindad. Rubí no deja de lamentarse el declive económico de su familia a partir de la muerte de su padre y se obsesiona con el dinero para poder salir de la vida paupérrima que le tocó vivir. Conocedora de su hermosura decide utilizar su belleza física como su mejor arma para atraer a un hombre apuesto, joven y con dinero que la convierta en una señora de fortuna, prestigio y de sociedad.

Para resolver el misterio de la muerte de Ian Andrews en un autobús, McDonald y Dodds deben adentrarse en la historia de la música y en el turbio mundo de las subastas de arte.

p.t: The Drawings of Yves Saint Laurent
p.d: La extraordinaria colección de bocetos del diseñador francés Yves Saint Laurent cobra vida en este reportaje dedicado a rescatar y honrar el legado del modisto.
Hélène regresa al escenario decidida a luchar contra quien intenta destruir a la orquesta. Para lograrlo tiene un arma infalible: su afinado oído.
Desaparecido a los 24 años, James Dean permanece como icono cultural. Transforma la percepción de la masculinidad al abrazar la vulnerabilidad, convirtiéndose en antihéroe.
Halle Berry, Chris Hemsworth, Rachel McAdams y John Bishop se unen a Graham en su sofá. Jessie Ware interpreta su nuevo sencillo.

p.d: A crippled man with a grudge against Earp hires sharpshooter Rule Hawes to kill him; Bat and the other deputies search for the assassin while Annie May tries to give Bat a clue.

p.t: How I Spent My Summer Vacation
p.d: Invited aboard a millionaire's (Peter Lawford) yacht, a young man (Robert Wagner) begins to suspect a conspiracy of murder.
A retired gunfighter (Rory Calhoun) and a saloon keeper (David Brian) play cards, with the saloon and a dance-hall girl (Piper Laurie) at stake.

California-bound rancher Ben Warren (Rock Hudson) is shot and left for dead when a demented ex-Confederate, Frank Slayton (Phil Carey), kidnaps his Southern bride-to-be (Donna Reed). Revived, Ben sets out to rescue her. Along the way, he picks up Jess Burgess (Leo Gordon), a slighted former member of Slayton's gang, and American Indian local Johash (Pat Hogan), who has his own beef with the outlaws. Together they embark on a perilous chase toward the Mexican border to stop Slayton.

Will Lockhart (James Stewart) comes to the ranch town of Coronado looking for the man who is selling rifles to the Apaches, because his brother was killed with one. There he runs into Alec Waggoman (Donald Crisp), an aging rancher with a violent son named Dave (Alex Nicol). A conflict between Dave and Vic (Arthur Kennedy), Waggoman's top aide, helps Lockhart uncover the source of the rifles -- and also gets him involved in the power struggles at the Waggoman ranch.

Near the end of the Civil War, Julia Hayne (Miriam Hopkins) travels to Libby Prison to convince Cmdr. Vance Irby (Randolph Scott) to help transport gold from Virginia City to the South. Union intelligence agent Kerry Bradford (Errol Flynn) breaks out of the prison and, learning of the plot for the gold, travels to Nevada, meeting Julia on the way. Sensing Julia is attracted to Kerry, Vance asks her to help set a trap while desperados led by Murrell (Humphrey Bogart) also close in on the gold.

Four ne'er-do-well sons reunite in their Texas hometown to attend their mother's funeral. Led by older brothers John (John Wayne), a gunfighter, and Tom (Dean Martin), a gambler, the four soon learn that their father gambled away the family ranch, which was the cause of his murder. The brothers decide to avenge their father's death and win back the ranch, a situation that quickly leads to trouble with the local sheriff and violent conflict with the rival Hastings clan.

As death row inmate Matthew Poncelet (Sean Penn) nears his execution date, he calls upon Sister Helen Prejean (Susan Sarandon) to help him with one last appeal, maintaining that he is innocent of the murders of a young couple. Poncelet begins to form a bond with Prejean, and she visits both his family and the relatives of the victims, hoping to learn more about the case. As things begin to look bleak for Poncelet, Prejean does all that she can to comfort and console the hardened convict.

College is up next for a group of high-school friends, so Francesca (Scarlett Johansson), the most daring of the group, suggests they steal SAT questions in order to increase their odds of getting into good universities. Hoop star Desmond (Darius Miles), studly Kyle (Chris Evans), working-class Matty (Bryan Greenberg), stoner Roy (Leonardo Nam) and foxy Anna (Erika Christensen) sign on for the scheme. But getting into the test facility after hours proves trickier than any multiple-choice exam.
When Jenny (Katherine Heigl) decides to marry a woman (Alexis Bledel), her conventional family must accept who she is or risk losing her forever.

England's Prince Albert must ascend the throne as King George VI, but he has a speech impediment. Knowing that the country needs her husband to be able to communicate effectively, Elizabeth hires Lionel Logue, an Australian actor and speech therapist, to help him overcome his stammer. An extraordinary friendship develops between the two men, as Logue uses unconventional means to teach the monarch how to speak with confidence.

Catherine (Gwyneth Paltrow) is a 27-year-old grieving after the loss of her father (Anthony Hopkins), a genius mathematician whose mind gradually deteriorated from mental illness. With her sister, Claire (Hope Davis), urging Catherine to leave their family home, and an ambitious student (Jake Gyllenhaal) searching through her father's notes, Catherine struggles to keep her composure and her sanity in this drama adapted from the stage play by David Auburn.

Framed for the murder of her husband, Libby Parsons (Ashley Judd) survives the long years in prison with two burning desires sustaining her -- finding her son and solving the mystery that destroyed her once-happy life. Standing between her and her quest, however, is her parole officer, Travis Lehman (Tommy Lee Jones). Libby poses a challenge to the cynical officer, one that forces him to face up to his own failings while pitting him against his superiors and law enforcement colleagues.

While out hunting, Llewelyn Moss (Josh Brolin) finds the grisly aftermath of a drug deal. Though he knows better, he cannot resist the cash left behind and takes it with him. The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh (Javier Bardem) picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell (Tommy Lee Jones), an aging lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss.

This spoof comedy takes shots at the slew of disaster movies that were released in the 70s. When the passengers and crew of a jet are incapacitated due to food poisoning, a rogue pilot with a drinking problem must cooperate with his ex-girlfriend turned stewardess to bring the plane to a safe landing.

Though haunted by combat memories, heroic pilot Ted Striker (Robert Hays) agrees to return to the cockpit to man the controls of Mayflower One, America's first commercial spacecraft. But, as soon as Mayflower One lifts off, an electrical malfunction sends the ship veering off course. A shaken Striker struggles to guide the shuttle through a treacherous asteroid belt, tame its failing computer systems and stop the disgruntled Joe Seluchi (Sonny Bono) from detonating a deadly bomb on board.

Josh (Breckin Meyer) videotapes his affair with another girl and accidentally mails it to his girlfriend. Discovering the mistake, he tows two of his college buddies -- and one not-so-eager kid who happens to own the car -- on a raucous 1,800-mile road trip from Ithaca, N.Y., to Austin, Texas, to save his lifelong romance.

New Jersey bartender Jon Martello knows what's important: his friends, his family, his car, his church, his sexual conquests -- and porn. In fact, Jon is a porn addict and has never had a genuine relationship with a woman. However, when he meets Barbara he has to change his operating methods, because Barbara won't be bedded easily. For the first time in his life, Jon begins a real courtship, but his obsession with erotica threatens to ruin everything.

Transported to an alternate universe, four young outsiders gain superhuman powers as they alter their physical form in shocking ways. Reed Richards becomes Mr. Fantastic, able to stretch and twist his body at will, while pal Ben Grimm gains immense strength as the Thing. Johnny Storm becomes the Human Torch, able to control and project fire, while his sister Sue becomes the Invisible Woman. Together, the team must harness their new abilities to prevent Doctor Doom from destroying the Earth.

Legendary space ranger Buzz Lightyear embarks on an intergalactic adventure alongside ambitious recruits Izzy, Mo, Darby, and his robot companion, Sox. As this motley crew tackles their toughest mission yet, they must learn to work together as a team to escape the evil Zurg and his dutiful robot army that are never far behind.

Despite his family's generations-old ban on music, young Miguel dreams of becoming an accomplished musician like his idol Ernesto de la Cruz. Desperate to prove his talent, Miguel finds himself in the stunning and colorful Land of the Dead. After meeting a charming trickster named Héctor, the two new friends embark on an extraordinary journey to unlock the real story behind Miguel's family history.

Woody (Tom Hanks), a good-hearted cowboy doll who belongs to a young boy named Andy (John Morris), sees his position as Andy's favorite toy jeopardized when his parents buy him a Buzz Lightyear (Tim Allen) action figure. Even worse, the arrogant Buzz thinks he's a real spaceman on a mission to return to his home planet. When Andy's family moves to a new house, Woody and Buzz must escape the clutches of maladjusted neighbor Sid Phillips (Erik von Detten) and reunite with their boy.

Woody (Tom Hanks) is stolen from his home by toy dealer Al McWhiggin (Wayne Knight), leaving Buzz Lightyear (Tim Allen) and the rest of the gang to try to rescue him. But when Woody discovers that he's actually a valuable collectible from a once-popular television show called "Woody's Roundup" and is reunited with his horse Bullseye, Jessie the yodeling cowgirl (Joan Cusack) and his faithful sidekick, Stinky Pete the Prospector (Kelsey Grammer), he doesn't want to leave.

With their beloved Andy preparing to leave for college, Woody (Tom Hanks), Buzz Lightyear (Tim Allen), Jessie (Joan Cusack), and the rest of the toys find themselves headed for the attic but mistakenly wind up on the curb with the trash. Woody's quick thinking saves the gang, but all but Woody end up being donated to a day-care center. Unfortunately, the uncontrollable kids do not play nice, so Woody and the gang make plans for a great escape.

Woody, Buzz Lightyear and the rest of the gang embark on a road trip with Bonnie and a new toy named Forky. The adventurous journey turns into an unexpected reunion as Woody's slight detour leads him to his long-lost friend Bo Peep. As Woody and Bo discuss the old days, they soon start to realize that they're worlds apart when it comes to what they want from life as a toy.

Andrew es un adolescente introvertido cuya principal forma de escape y expresión es una cámara de video. Pero las cosas empiezan a cambiar cuando Andrew, su primo Matt y el popular compañero Steve descubren una misteriosa sustancia que les da unos poderes increíbles. Sus habilidades se hacen más poderosas y sus vidas se salen de control cuando emergen sus lados más oscuros. Andrew captura los eventos con su cámara.

In 1941 Berlin, the Gestapo's efforts to uncover the source of vital information broadcast by American correspondent Bill Roberts remain elusive. The Gestapo colonel in charge of the investigation presses his fiancée, Karen Hauen, to help and, with reluctance, she agrees. After befriending Bill, Karen discovers how he receives the information, but when she also learns who provides it, she is exposed for the first time to the brutal tactics of her government.

While on a train, writer Richard Harland (Cornel Wilde) strikes up a relationship with the gorgeous Ellen Berent (Gene Tierney). Ellen quickly becomes obsessed with Richard and abandons her fiancé, Russell Quinton (Vincent Price), to be with him. The couple rushes into marriage, with both of them caught up in romance and Richard intrigued by Ellen's intensity. Only after settling into marriage, however, does Richard realize that she is psychotically jealous and highly unstable.

Roustabout Stanton Carlisle joins a traveling carny and unsuccessfully schemes to figure out the mind-reading act of Mademoiselle Zeena and her alcoholic husband, Pete. But when Pete dies, Zeena is forced to take on Stanton as a partner, and he quickly proves more gifted than his predecessor. Ambitious to a fault, Carlisle abandons Zeena and the carny to reinvent himself as The Great Stanton, wowing high-class audiences in a Chicago hotel.

Ashamed that his father lived a life of crime, hard-boiled New York City cop Mark Dixon has a reputation for being too tough on criminals. So when Dixon unintentionally kills a murder suspect during a routine questioning, he hides the fact from the department and tries to pin the killing on his nemesis, notorious gangster Scalise. The snag in the cop's plan comes when his boss wrongly accuses the father of Dixon's love interest, Morgan, of the murder.

When a gay man is viciously slain, Detective Joe Leland (Frank Sinatra) is put on the case. Joe eventually tracks down the victim's roommate, who confesses to the crime and is sentenced to death; however, the outcome of the case doesn't sit well with the detective. Norma (Jacqueline Bisset), a distraught widow, visits Joe. She believes her husband's death was no accident, but the cops don't seem to care. Joe begins to investigate, and stumbles on a cover-up related to his previous case.

Just after becoming the director of the Psychoneurotic Institute for the Very, Very Nervous, Dr. Richard H. Thorndyke is greeted by a series of mysterious events. When his colleagues -- including the militaristic and mustachioed Nurse Diesel -- become leery of his questions, they accuse him of murder. Thorndyke's own mental health comes into question as he struggles to clear his name in the midst of a crippling bout of a condition known as high anxiety.

p.t: La gran aventura de los Lunnis y el libro mágico
p.d: La fantasía está en peligro. El malvado Crudo ha descubierto la forma de terminar con el Libro Mágico, que contiene todas las historias inventadas por la humanidad. Una niña de 9 años es la elegida para salvarla con la ayuda de sus amigos los Lunnis.

Quentin es un joven con mala suerte en el amor que se encuentra con su inalcanzable y enigmática vecina en la ventana de su cuarto. Luego de vivir una aventura de una noche recorriendo la ciudad, él deberá rastrearla para volverla a ver.

Un multimillonario quiere rodar una película destinada a marcar una época y, por ello, contrata al mejor elenco disponible en el mundo. Sin embargo, el cóctel de estrellas va a generar más problemas que beneficios a la producción.
Emma Woodhouse es una joven inglesa que se ocupa de las relaciones de quienes la rodean, aunque a veces de una manera un tanto entrometida.

Después de haber asesinado a Tiberio, su abuelo adoptivo, Calígula se convierte en el emperador de Roma. A partir de ese momento, la violencia, la depravación sexual y la corrupción, mezcladas con la paranoia y el despotismo, se adueñan de Roma.
Después de tomar un camino equivocado en la carretera, una pareja decide detenerse en un restaurante para comer y relajarse. Su divertido viaje pronto se convierte en una lucha por la supervivencia.
Niños intentan detener al fantasma de una mujer que secuestra niños que vagan por el bosque durante la noche, debido a su sentimiento de culpa por haber ahogado a sus propios hijos.
Una guardia de seguridad es transferida a una morgue y descubre que las sombras y silencios ocultan un tormento sin retorno.
Un hombre debe hacer un largo viaje por carretera con un taxista que curiosamente tiene una aventura con su esposa.

Sarah es una astronauta francesa divorciada que enfrenta el desprecio de algunos de sus colegas por el hecho de ser mujer. Además, Sarah se siente culpable porque apenas tiene tiempo libre para dedicárselo a Stella, su hija de 8 años. La situación se agrava cuando la escogen para participar en una misión que la mantendrá un año alejada del hogar.

Nic y Jules son una pareja de lesbianas que viven con sus dos hijos adolescentes: Joni y Laser, ambos fruto de la inseminación artificial. Lo que obsesiona a los dos chicos es conocer a su padre biológico, hasta que uno de ellos se anima a hacerlo.

La vida de una pareja bien acomodada, que se ha mudado a una maravillosa casa en la costa de California, cambia radicalmente cuando comienzan a recibir misteriosos regalos de un antiguo compañero de clase. Tras más de veinte años ocultos, los secretos de su pasado empiezan a emerger.

Los participantes de una terapia de asesinos anónimos, quienes se reúnen cada semana para dialogar y aliviar los remordimientos confesando sus atrocidades, intentan averiguar cuál de ellos es el culpable del atentado contra un senador.
Una agente secreta se ve obligada a participar en un juego psicológico con su propia mente, al tiempo que es perseguida por el programa que la creó.
Una pareja se encuentra, sin saberlo, con una entidad maligna que posee a los hombres, despojándolos lentamente de sus identidades.

p.t: Bohemian Rhapsody, la historia de Freddie Mercury
p.d: Freddie Mercury desafía los estereotipos y se convierte en uno de los vocalistas más reconocidos de la música mundial. Después de dejar la banda Queen para seguir una carrera como solista, Mercury se reúne con la banda para dar una de las mejores actuaciones en la historia del rock 'n' roll.
Evan Luke, un veterano agente de la CIA, se ve obligado a volver a su trabajo para enfrentarse a Banir, un peligroso terrorista al que creía haber eliminado hace años.

Hubert, un policía francés, recibe una llamada desde Tokio informándole que su antigua amante ha muerto y que es el padre de una adolescente. El agente viaja a Japón, donde descubrirá que la Yakuza es culpable de la muerte de la mujer.

Un agente del tesoro persigue a un contador que trabaja para varias organizaciones criminales. Mientras más cerca de su nuca siente el peso de la justicia, el contador va tomando medidas más drásticas para mantener a salvo su doble vida y su libertad.

Una banda de ladrones que se considera a sí misma una versión contemporánea de Robin Hood le pide ayuda a un ladrón de fama internacional para robar un cargamento de lingotes de oro escondidos debajo de una prisión.

Encarcelado por un crimen que no cometió, Jensen Ames, el tres veces campeón de automovilismo, se encuentra en la prisión más dura del país, pero tiene una oportunidad inesperada de libertad cuando le ofrecen competir en la carrera de la muerte.
Un hombre que cree estar más allá de la redención busca su propia versión de la justicia y es recompensado, aunque solo fugazmente, con amor.

El joven piloto Maverick Mitchell acude a una prestigiosa escuela aérea, famosa por formar a los mejores pilotos de combate del país. Maverick se siente atraído por su hermosa instructora, mientras desarrolla una intensa rivalidad con otro piloto.

En el siglo XIV, unos caballeros trasladan a una mujer sospechosa de brujería a un monasterio. Allí, los monjes llegan a la conclusión de que los poderes de la mujer podrían ser la causa de la peste negra.
Una persona adulta mayor es atacada, pero un joven boxeador la defiende y se gana la fama en medio de la pandemia de Covid 19.
Liberado de una cárcel mexicana, un hombre viaja con su hijo cruzando la frontera a Estados Unidos.
Una ex estrella de fútbol regresa al hogar, y ofrece ayudar al equipo de fútbol hasta hacerlos ganadores.

Pedro Picapiedra no puede creerse su buena suerte cuando le nombran vicepresidente de su compañía. Sin embargo, el cavernícola no sabe que le han tendido una trampa para hacerle el responsable legal de un desfalco.

Las habilidades de lucha de Dre Parker no son rivales para Cheng, el acosador de la escuela. Dre conoce al Sr. Han, un empleado de mantenimiento y maestro de artes marciales. El Sr. Han enseña kung-fu a Dre para que sea capaz de enfrentarse a Cheng.
Cuatro años después de la destrucción de la Isla Nublar, los dinosaurios viven y cazan junto a los humanos en todo el mundo. Este frágil equilibrio remodelará el futuro de la especie humana.

En la década de 1970, un grupo de soldados y exploradores, acompañados por una fotoperiodista, llega a una isla del Pacífico habitada por un simio gigantesco y otros monstruos. Marlow, un peculiar habitante del lugar, guía a los aventureros a través de las misteriosas junglas y marismas de la isla.
Cuando Paris secuestra a Helena de Troya, el feroz guerrero Aquiles dirige a las fuerzas griegas en la batalla de Troya.
Fong es un ladrón que siempre pierde todo lo ganado en las apuestas. Su gran oportunidad llegará de la mano de un mafioso que le pide que secuestre al bebé.
Un soldado de las fuerzas especiales se ve atrapado en un vórtice temporal apareciendo en tiempos medievales. Ahí descubrirá que está destinado a cumplir una profecía y redimir a todo un pueblo.
Un joven ingeniero chino descubre una conspiración en África cuyo objetivo es obtener un suculento contrato ligado al negocio de la alta tecnología.
Con la ayuda de su nuevo compañero, un policía conflictivo recibe la oportunidad de detener a una pandilla de adversarios de su pasado.

Becky y Hunter, dos amigas aficionadas al alpinismo, quedan atrapadas en la torre de telecomunicaciones de la cima de una montaña que acaban de escalar. Sin provisiones y afectadas por el vértigo, comienza la lucha por la supervivencia.

Un agente retirado de operaciones especiales debe enfrentarse a un equipo de asesinos para rescatar a su maestro secuestrado.

La vida de una pareja bien acomodada, que se ha mudado a una maravillosa casa en la costa de California, cambia radicalmente cuando comienzan a recibir misteriosos regalos de un antiguo compañero de clase. Tras más de veinte años ocultos, los secretos de su pasado empiezan a emerger.

Una terrible plaga ha dividido a la población del planeta en zombis y humanos. R, uno de los muertos vivientes, sorprende a sus hermanos atacando a una joven llamada Julie y la rescata. Julie ve que R es diferente a los demás, y la pareja se embarca en una extraña relación.
Una persona adulta mayor es atacada, pero un joven boxeador la defiende y se gana la fama en medio de la pandemia de Covid 19.
Liberado de una cárcel mexicana, un hombre viaja con su hijo cruzando la frontera a Estados Unidos.
Una ex estrella de fútbol regresa al hogar, y ofrece ayudar al equipo de fútbol hasta hacerlos ganadores.

Pedro Picapiedra no puede creerse su buena suerte cuando le nombran vicepresidente de su compañía. Sin embargo, el cavernícola no sabe que le han tendido una trampa para hacerle el responsable legal de un desfalco.

Daniel LaRusso llega a Los Ángeles dispuesto a hacer amigos, pero rápidamente se convierte en el blanco de los ataques de un grupo de estudiantes de karate. Por eso, le pide ayuda a Miyagi, un maestro de artes marciales que cambiará su vida.
Cuatro años después de la destrucción de la Isla Nublar, los dinosaurios viven y cazan junto a los humanos en todo el mundo. Este frágil equilibrio remodelará el futuro de la especie humana.

En la década de 1970, un grupo de soldados y exploradores, acompañados por una fotoperiodista, llega a una isla del Pacífico habitada por un simio gigantesco y otros monstruos. Marlow, un peculiar habitante del lugar, guía a los aventureros a través de las misteriosas junglas y marismas de la isla.
Cuando Paris secuestra a Helena de Troya, el feroz guerrero Aquiles dirige a las fuerzas griegas en la batalla de Troya.

Hoy Ximena Sáenz arma una mesa de brunch con recetas clásicas argentinas: una pastafrola de nuez, y unos alfajores de chocotorta. Además, recibe a su amigo Tomás que trajo sándwiches de miga 2.0, y ella lo sorprende con un sándwich Montecristo.
El maestro Osvaldo Gross trae recetas para los amantes del chocolate: cake de chocolate y un delicioso cake húmedo de chocolate.

p.t: El Camino de Santiago by Julius
p.d: A su llegada a Ribadeo, Julius conoce a Coté, una percebeira que le enseña todos los secretos para pescar y cocinar los percebes a la perfección. Muy cerca, en Rinlo, Amalia lo recibe con un delicioso arroz caldoso con mariscos.

p.t: Los favoritos de Alex Ruiz en Oaxaca
p.d: Descubren los favoritos de Alex. El Mercado de Tlacolula ofrece Cocina de Humo y el Chef Alex Ruiz muestra cómo se prepara un taco placero. Luego se visita Oaxacalifornia. Además, El Jinete, El Lechoncito de oro y Origen.

En Fontiveros, provincia de Ávila, Ifi prepara lentejas a lo pobre. En Robres, provincia de Huesca, Ángela y Vicenta cocinan tortilla de patata con salsa verde. Y en Cuevas de Velasco, José Antonio enseña cómo elaborar las típicas gachas de almortas.
Blanca prepara tres deliciosas recetas en la freidora sin aceite: ñoquis crujientes con salsa de tomate casera, pavo Wellington con espinacas y pastel de plátano con chocolate.

p.t: La panadería dulce de Juan Manuel
p.d: Juan Manuel comparte desde los clásicos de la panadería dulce hasta las delicias más sofisticadas del mundo. En este episodio: una infalible receta de medialunas de grasa y un clásico de Francia, el kouign-amann.

p.t: Celebrar en casa con Julieta y Felicitas
p.d: ¿Cuánta comida se calcula por invitado? ¿Qué conviene tener hecho y qué dejar para último momento? Todas estas respuestas te las dan Felicitas Pizarro y Julieta Oriolo. En este episodio, Feli cocina caracú con puré de papas, y Juli, stracciatella dulce con frutos rojos.

Serie en la que la pastelería es la protagonista. En cada capítulo, se proponen recetas dulces sencillas y prácticas, con un estilo fresco y desenfadado. Desde clásicos reinventados hasta opciones rápidas para todos los días.

p.t: Los Petersen en el norte argentino
p.d: Los hermanos Petersen recorren la ruta del vino más alta del mundo. Visitan una bodega de 500 hectáreas bajo el sol de Cafayate. Además, Christian Petersen revela todos los consejos y trucos para hornear una carne de cabrito tierna y suave.

"Guardianes de Tradición" desembarca en uno de los lugares más emblemáticos de Santa Fé, Confitería y Pastelería Las Delicias. Conoceremos el secreto de la preparación del hojaldre y los clásicos alfajores que ningún turista olvida al pasar por el lugar.
Mauricio Asta invita a preparar un arrollado de chocolate y café en casa con ingredientes sencillos. También cocina un hojaldre alemán de plátano, ideal para un postre un poco más formal.

Se presentan tres delicias imperdibles: un cremoso helado de mascarpone, oriundo de la ciudad de Quilmes; un sabroso puchero, y una calabaza que, con la suma de algunos ingredientes, se transforma en una exquisitez.

La Hermana Verónica abre la cocina del convento para compartir las recetas que aprendió en todos los años de su vida en comunidad. Recetas sencillas de distintos orígenes, deliciosas e ideales para una mesa compartida.

p.t: La panadería dulce de Juan Manuel
p.d: Juan Manuel Herrera enseña las técnicas y comparte todos los tips de un sinfín de recetas sabrosas de la panadería dulce. Hoy: pan fruto y anillo del desierto con levadura de masa madre.

Canadian Mountie O'Rourke (Alan Ladd) and his Cree companion, Cajou (Jay Silverheels), come upon the scorched remains of a wagon train and find beautiful lone survivor Grace (Shelley Winters), who claims the attack was carried out by American Indians. Realizing the attack is only the beginning, the men fear war between the American Sioux, the Canadian Cree and the whites. O'Rourke must now protect his troops from further attack and save Grace from being extradited to Montana on a murder charge.

The last job of Calvary Captain Nathan Brittles (John Wayne) before retirement is to soothe relations with the Cheyenne and Arapaho Indians after Custer's last stand. At the same time, he must transport the wife (Mildred Natwick) and niece (Joanne Dru) of his commanding officer to a safe destination. After both his missions stall, Brittles attempts a face-to-face meeting with an important Native American chief in order to stave off an impending war.

Ancient cultures from around the world believed that meteorites were sacred stones imbued with the power of the gods. Ancient astronaut theorists ask whether these space rocks could be pieces of extraterrestrial technology.

Buckle up as we take you on a wild journey into the world of vintage daredevils who risked it all for a rush. From the enigmatic Human Fly to skateboard speed demons and diving horses, these stunts were as reckless as they were unforgettable.

The modern concept of extreme sports is a product of marketing, but back in the old days, the rules (or lack thereof) of our nation's sports made them truly extreme. From bone-crushing football and deadly baseball games to wild events like auto polo.

Exploding cars and blimp disasters to kids sent through the mail and doomed personal helicopters, the past is packed with jaw-dropping travel tales and the remarkable misfires that paved the road to modern transportation.

Snack on a feast of food horrors from the past: from radioactive energy drinks, to scandalous snacks made with Olestra, to the appalling additives in your milk and bread, we uncover the incredible things people once ate without a second thought.

p.d: When after school programs see their funding cut, teachers Josh and Ella turn to fundraising before banding together in search of a larger donation, falling hard along the way.

p.t: Rey Arturo: La leyenda de la espada
p.d: Arturo fue robado al nacer y tuvo una educación espartana en una zona conflictiva de la ciudad, pero cuando extrae la espada Excalibur de la piedra en la que estaba clavada, la profecía se cumple y acepta el destino de liderar a su pueblo.
Las enormes olas de Nazaré continúan desafiando y confundiendo a los mejores surfistas del mundo, y se llevan a cabo varios rescates dramáticos cerca de las peligrosas rocas.
Anacronismos acerca de un cuento popular sobre un joven campesino que mejora su suerte cuando se disfraza de caballero.

El Escarabajo, una antigua reliquia extraterrestre, elige al estudiante Jaime Reyes como el huésped simbiótico en cuyo cuerpo resguardarse. A partir de ese momento, Jaime desarrolla una armadura que le otorga poderes increíbles e impredecibles.

El profesor de simbología Robert Langdon se despierta con amnesia en Italia. Allí contará con la ayuda de la doctora Sienna Brooks para, juntos, recorrer Europa intentando desbaratar una conspiración letal que amenaza a todo el planeta.

Un adversario inesperado y despiadado ataca demasiado cerca de casa. Kara Zor-El, también conocida como Supergirl, une fuerzas a regañadientes con un compañero improbable en un épico viaje interestelar de venganza y justicia.

En un futuro distópico, los EE. UU. están en guerra civil debido a un movimiento secesionista. Un equipo de periodistas acompaña a unos militares a Washington D.C. mientras las fuerzas californianas y texanas intentan conquistar la capital.

Los mejores amigos Griff y Doug se dirigen a la selva amazónica para filmar una nueva versión de su película favorita, "Anaconda". Sin embargo, la vida pronto imita al arte cuando una anaconda gigante sedienta de sangre comienza a cazarlos.

Durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial, un caza japonés hunde un buque de guerra australiano en el mar de Timor. Un grupo de soldados se aferra a una balsa improvisada mientras intentan sobrevivir. Un tiburón blanco nada en el agua cercana.

El multimillonario tecnológico Lex Luthor aprovecha la oportunidad para quitarse de en medio definitivamente al Hombre de Acero. ¿Podrán la reportera Lois Lane y el compañero de cuatro patas de Superman, Krypto, ayudarle antes de que sea tarde?

Based on the play by Tennessee Williams, this renowned drama follows troubled former schoolteacher Blanche DuBois (Vivien Leigh) as she leaves small-town Mississippi and moves in with her sister, Stella Kowalski (Kim Hunter), and her husband, Stanley (Marlon Brando), in New Orleans. Blanche's flirtatious Southern-belle presence causes problems for Stella and Stanley, who already have a volatile relationship, leading to even greater conflict in the Kowalski household.

p.d: John Oliver tackles the rise of monthly subscriptions and their impact on consumers; what could be more embarrassing than liking Madame Web?

p.t: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)
p.d: Former cinema superhero Riggan Thomson (Michael Keaton) is mounting an ambitious Broadway production that he hopes will breathe new life into his stagnant career. It's risky, but he hopes that his creative gamble will prove that he's a real artist and not just a washed-up movie star. As opening night approaches, a castmate is injured, forcing Riggan to hire an actor (Edward Norton) who is guaranteed to shake things up. Meanwhile, Riggan must deal with his girlfriend, daughter and ex-wife.
Following fresh recruit John Stewart and Green Lantern legend Hal Jordan, two intergalactic cops drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery.

JAŸ-Z discusses the pitfalls of early fame, the East Coast-West Coast rap beef, and his relationships with The Notorious B.I.G. and Tupac.

India Stoker's (Mia Wasikowska) world comes crashing down when her father (Jacki Weaver) dies in a car accident. Adding to the girl's emotional turmoil is the sudden arrival of Charlie (Matthew Goode), an uncle whom she never knew existed. Charlie moves in with India and her unstable mother (Nicole Kidman), and soon India begins to suspect that this charming and mysterious man has ulterior motives. However, instead of feeling alarmed, India becomes increasingly infatuated with him.

Blanche, que pertenece a una rancia, pero arruinada familia sureña, es una mujer madura y decadente que vive anclada en el pasado. A pesar de su actitud remilgada y arrogante, Blanche oculta un escabroso pasado que la ha conducido al desequilibrio mental. Diana, hija de dioses y princesa de las amazonas, nunca ha salido de su isla, hasta que un piloto accidentado que llega a la isla le explica que se está desarrollando una gran guerra que puede destruir el mundo, y Diana parte a la batalla.

En la Inglaterra del siglo XIII, un arquero habilidoso y sus hombres enfrentan a un déspota y evitan que se desate una guerra civil.
Un agente de la CIA debe abrirse camino en territorio hostil hasta un punto de extracción en Kandahar.

Atormentada por una violenta pesadilla recurrente, una universitaria regresa a casa para buscar a la única persona que podría romper el ciclo de muerte y salvar a su familia del espantoso final que inevitablemente les espera.
Un vistazo al espectáculo de Stray Kids en el marco de su exitosa gira mundial, junto a exclusivo material detrás de escena y entrevistas íntimas con los miembros.

Después de rechazar una lucrativa oferta de un empresario, Speed Racer descubre que algunas de las más importantes carreras están arregladas por magnates sin principios, que manipulan a los principales pilotos de carrera para tener más ganancias.

Cuando los monstruos quieren salir de paseo, todos ellos van al Hotel Transilvania del Conde Drácula, un sitio espléndido en donde pueden ser ellos mismos sin seres humanos que los molesten. En un fin de semana especial, Drácula invita a criaturas como el Hombre Invisible, la Momia y otros a celebrar el cumpleaños 118 de su hija Mavis. Sin embargo, una complicación inesperada se desarrolla cuando un hombre ordinario llega a la fiesta y se enamora de Mavis.
Shrek y sus amigos van en busca del verdadero heredero de la Tierra Muy Muy Lejana, mientras la Princesa Fiona intenta evitar que el Príncipe Encantador ocupe el trono.

Un equipo cinematográfico sigue a un pingüino adolescente que se dirige a la isla Pen Gu para participar en su primera competición profesional de surf.

Cuatro inadaptados son arrastrados por un portal al Overworld, un misterioso lugar que se nutre de la imaginación. Para volver a casa, tendrán que dominar el terreno mientras se embarcan en una búsqueda con un artesano llamado Steve.
Un cerdo, un ratón, un puerco espín, un gorila, un elefante y otros animales se reúnen en un teatro para una competencia de canto.

Una operación une a un policía y a su fiel perro policía, dando nacimiento a Dog Man, quien debe aprender a aceptar su nueva identidad y evitar que el supervillano felino Petey el Gato se clone a sí mismo y realice una ola de crímenes.

Un ogro llamado Shrek vive en su pantano, pero su preciada soledad se ve súbitamente interrumpida por la invasión de los ruidosos personajes de los cuentos de hadas. Todos fueron expulsados de sus reinos por el malvado Lord Farquaad. p.d: En los años setenta, Bill Loud y su esposa, Pat, permiten que unas cámaras graben sus vidas personales para la serie de PBS An American Family.

Tracii trabaja para garantizar la seguridad de las mujeres que buscan un aborto ante nuevas restricciones. Acompaña al personal que continúa brindando diversos servicios médicos en un entorno donde las clínicas a menudo enfrentan amenazas diarias.

Daemon y la Serpiente Marina luchan contra el Alimenta Cangrejos. El reino celebra el segundo día del nombre de Aegon. Rhaenyra se enfrenta a la posibilidad de un matrimonio.
Luego de que Rhaenyra interrumpe su recorrido por Westeros, Daemon le presenta a la princesa la calle de la seda después del anochecer.

King's Landing está celebrando la próxima boda de Rhaenyra, que se espera que repare el desgarro que data de hace más de 10 años. En el banquete, la familia real lucha por estar unida y esto repercute en el éxito de las celebraciones.
Han pasado diez años y Rhaenyra está cansada de las sospechas de la reina Alicent sobre sus hijos. Mientras tanto, Daemon y su nueva esposa, Laena Velaryon, reciben una oferta en Pentos.
Mientras todos se reúnen en el hogar de la Casa Velaryon para un funeral en el que Rhaenyra confronta a Daemon, Viserys pide el fin de las luchas internas en la familia, y Alicent exige justicia.

p.t: A Reason to Live, A Reason to Die
p.d: After surrendering Fort Holman to the Confederacy without there being a single shot fired, Col. Pembroke (James Coburn) faces public disgrace and a potential court-martial unless he's able to recapture the fort now held by the power-mad Maj. Ward (Telly Savalas). To help him on this mission, Pembroke enlists a ragtag bunch of condemned men who are promised their freedom should they survive. Despite much internal strife, the group gradually comes together in time for the assault.

Quirt Evans (John Wayne), a cowboy on the run, is injured when his horse stumbles near a Quaker family's land. The family takes him in as he regains his health, and he falls for their young daughter, Penelope (Gail Russell). As Quirt falls deeper in love and becomes accustomed to the family's peaceful ways, his violent past starts to catch up to him. Eventually he is forced to decide whether it is worth letting go of his turbulent former life for his future with Penelope.

Aging rancher George Washington McLintock, a wealthy self-made man, is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men, McLintock's own sons and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife, who left him two years previously, suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in her husband -- she wants custody of their daughter.

Remember when "everybody's doing it" was the reason enough to dive in headfirst?; from gravity-defying flagpole sitting and phone booth cramming, to pet skunks and goldfish gulpers, revealing the crazes that are sweeping the nation; these obsessions are risky and impossible to resist; it is a trip back to the fads that push the limits and make hazardous history must-see mayhem.

Remember when looking your best meant risking life and limb?; from dentures that could explode at the dinner table and stiff shirt collars that strangled people to death, to toxic hair implants and tanning pills that left them glowing orange.

Remember when playtime meant tempting fate?; from toy belts that fire speeding projectiles, to high-powered pogo sticks that send people soaring, to dolls that try to eat people alive, these playthings are made for kids, but their risks are anything but child's play; it's a mind-blowing, bone-rattling trip through the toys of yesteryear that remind people of a time when childhood was wild, free, and hazardous.

Remember when hitting the road meant flirting with disaster?; from rumble seats that turn passengers into projectiles, to scorching cigarette lighters built right into the dash, to cars that have a habit of going up in flames, even a simple trip can go south; these are the bright ideas and questionable designs that turn people daily commute into a demolition derby; it's a high-speed, white-knuckle ride back to a time when the rules of the road were still being written.

Remember when having a modern home meant living on the edge of danger?; from backyard trash fires and waterbeds that turn bedrooms into flood zones, to electric fans that snatch fingers and garden hoses that serve up toxic sips of water, domestic life is full of hidden peril; these are the familiar fixes and convenient comforts that turn out to be far from safe; it's a hair-raising, eye-opening trip back to the homegrown hazards that can make you wonder what are we thinking?

Remember when hobbies were more than just a way to pass the time — they were a chance to push the limits? From making model planes with glue that gets you high, to cooking up explosive rocket fuel in the backyard, to strapping ourselves to homemade kites and launching into the unknown, these hands-on pursuits often came with a dangerous edge; it's a thrilling, hair-raising trip back to the crafty obsessions that prove our hazardous history was never just a hobby.

Remember when popular tourist attractions came with real danger? From climbing onto the backs of live alligators, to hand-feeding hungry bears, to scoring front-row seats to atomic blasts, these heart-pounding experiences promised irresistible thrills you'd never forget - where the risk was part of the draw; it's a jaw-dropping, pulse-racing trip back to the places that prove our hazardous history wasn't just entertaining - it was a death-defying must-see!

Remember when being part of the crowd meant taking your chances? From packing in shoulder to shoulder for front row views of Civil War battles, to lining up to watch dead whales explode, to full-blown riots while shopping, the biggest shared moments didn't just bring people together - they stirred things up; it's a wild, edge-of-your-seat trip back to the gatherings that prove our hazardous history was anything but orderly - but always had an eager audience!

When earning a paycheck meant risking life and limb; from dangling off skyscrapers without safety harnesses and riding runaway logs down raging rivers, to digging up corpses for cash and selling your own blood to scrape by, people once took unbelievable risks no paycheck could truly cover; whether racing pizzas across town at breakneck speed or pulling off death-defying Hollywood stunts, people once did whatever it took to earn a living.

When being young meant testing the limits of what our bodies could survive; from launching our bikes off homemade ramps and playing chicken in traffic, to using dangerous construction sites as our playground, childhood adventure was often intertwined with how far you were willing to go—and the consequences that came with it; armed with cherry bombs, slingshots and more confidence than caution, we pushed boundaries in ways that would make parents today shudder.

From personal jetpacks that promised to send us sky-high, to electrified exercise machines that shocked us into shape, to firefighting hand grenades hurled straight into the flames, yesterday's boldest inventions were packed with promise and risks nobody saw coming; these are the ambitious ideas, futuristic gadgets and engineering marvels that aimed to revolutionize everyday life, but sometimes overshot the mark.

Hoy en día, más gente que nunca antes en la historia cree que los objetos voladores no identificados son de origen extraterrestre. ¿Son capaces de alterar las leyes que rigen el tiempo y el espacio tal y como las conocemos?

Remember when "everybody's doing it" was the reason enough to dive in headfirst?; from gravity-defying flagpole sitting and phone booth cramming, to pet skunks and goldfish gulpers, revealing the crazes that are sweeping the nation; these obsessions are risky and impossible to resist; it is a trip back to the fads that push the limits and make hazardous history must-see mayhem.

Remember when looking your best meant risking life and limb?; from dentures that could explode at the dinner table and stiff shirt collars that strangled people to death, to toxic hair implants and tanning pills that left them glowing orange.

Remember when playtime meant tempting fate?; from toy belts that fire speeding projectiles, to high-powered pogo sticks that send people soaring, to dolls that try to eat people alive, these playthings are made for kids, but their risks are anything but child's play; it's a mind-blowing, bone-rattling trip through the toys of yesteryear that remind people of a time when childhood was wild, free, and hazardous.

Remember when hitting the road meant flirting with disaster?; from rumble seats that turn passengers into projectiles, to scorching cigarette lighters built right into the dash, to cars that have a habit of going up in flames, even a simple trip can go south; these are the bright ideas and questionable designs that turn people daily commute into a demolition derby; it's a high-speed, white-knuckle ride back to a time when the rules of the road were still being written.

Remember when having a modern home meant living on the edge of danger?; from backyard trash fires and waterbeds that turn bedrooms into flood zones, to electric fans that snatch fingers and garden hoses that serve up toxic sips of water, domestic life is full of hidden peril; these are the familiar fixes and convenient comforts that turn out to be far from safe; it's a hair-raising, eye-opening trip back to the homegrown hazards that can make you wonder what are we thinking?

Remember when hobbies were more than just a way to pass the time — they were a chance to push the limits? From making model planes with glue that gets you high, to cooking up explosive rocket fuel in the backyard, to strapping ourselves to homemade kites and launching into the unknown, these hands-on pursuits often came with a dangerous edge; it's a thrilling, hair-raising trip back to the crafty obsessions that prove our hazardous history was never just a hobby.

Remember when popular tourist attractions came with real danger? From climbing onto the backs of live alligators, to hand-feeding hungry bears, to scoring front-row seats to atomic blasts, these heart-pounding experiences promised irresistible thrills you'd never forget - where the risk was part of the draw; it's a jaw-dropping, pulse-racing trip back to the places that prove our hazardous history wasn't just entertaining - it was a death-defying must-see!

Remember when being part of the crowd meant taking your chances? From packing in shoulder to shoulder for front row views of Civil War battles, to lining up to watch dead whales explode, to full-blown riots while shopping, the biggest shared moments didn't just bring people together - they stirred things up; it's a wild, edge-of-your-seat trip back to the gatherings that prove our hazardous history was anything but orderly - but always had an eager audience!

When earning a paycheck meant risking life and limb; from dangling off skyscrapers without safety harnesses and riding runaway logs down raging rivers, to digging up corpses for cash and selling your own blood to scrape by, people once took unbelievable risks no paycheck could truly cover; whether racing pizzas across town at breakneck speed or pulling off death-defying Hollywood stunts, people once did whatever it took to earn a living.

When being young meant testing the limits of what our bodies could survive; from launching our bikes off homemade ramps and playing chicken in traffic, to using dangerous construction sites as our playground, childhood adventure was often intertwined with how far you were willing to go—and the consequences that came with it; armed with cherry bombs, slingshots and more confidence than caution, we pushed boundaries in ways that would make parents today shudder.

From personal jetpacks that promised to send us sky-high, to electrified exercise machines that shocked us into shape, to firefighting hand grenades hurled straight into the flames, yesterday's boldest inventions were packed with promise and risks nobody saw coming; these are the ambitious ideas, futuristic gadgets and engineering marvels that aimed to revolutionize everyday life, but sometimes overshot the mark.
Se explora un mundo donde la piel animal puede reemplazar la humana, donde los médicos dan enemas de café y un mundo de jarabe para la tos con heroína.

El concepto moderno de deportes extremos es un producto del marketing, pero en los viejos tiempos, la falta de reglas los hacía verdaderamente extremos: desde el fútbol aplastante y los partidos de béisbol mortales hasta eventos salvajes.
Recreaciones, testigos y expertos ayudan a revelar los misterios detrás de algunos de los desastres más famosos de la ingeniería.

Dos empresas de calzado se convierten en titanes de la industria en una batalla que se dirime en varias décadas.

La creación de un artefacto nace de la conjugación entre la invención y el estilo de vida del hombre. ¿Quién no recuerda cuando vio por primera vez un iPhone, la navaja Swiss Army, el Walkman y los condones? ¿Cuántas personas realmente saben que la radio de transistor fue el creador del rocanrol, o que un casete derrocó al Sha de Irán? La revista "Mecánica Popular e Historia" se unen para llevarle un especial donde conocerá cuáles son los 101 artefactos que han cambiado al mundo.

Una familia de Long Island desentraña un misterio enterrado por décadas sobre la desaparición de su padre, George Carroll.

Una profesora de danza recibe un mensaje de su exmarido, quien se apunta con una pistola en la cabeza: dice que se dirige al estudio de danza y amenaza con asesinar a la familia. Los agentes se apresuran para llegar y le suplican que se retire.
Una joven regresa a casa luego de una reunión familiar y otra sale a comprar una medicina. Sin advertencia, ambas son secuestradas.

La estudiante de secundaria Michelle Miller se une al programa Futuros Soldados, un paso preliminar para cumplir su sueño: enlistarse en el Ejército. Pero un romance prohibido pone en riesgo su carrera y su futuro.
La madre soltera de 27 años, Laura Ackerson, busca un nuevo comienzo en Raleigh, Carolina del Norte. Empieza una nueva compañía y nuevas relaciones, mientras lucha por la custodia de sus dos hijos.
Rhonda Smith es una hermosa madre soltera, que confía en la amabilidad de los extraños en la iglesia hasta que uno de ellos se aleja del buen camino y la traiciona.
El actor Thom Bierdz lleva a su hermano pequeño problemático, Troy, a Los Ángeles para ponerlo en su lugar; sin embargo, Bierdz se equivoca y paga con la vida de un ser querido.

Ashley Pittman cree que le tocó la lotería al casarse con Jeffrey Scott, y él le da una vida más cómoda que la que dejó atrás en el pequeño pueblo de Luisiana. Sin embargo, a puerta cerrada, un secreto pronto se vuelve mortal.

Pepita Redhair, una mujer navaja de 27 años, desaparece después de que su madre la dejara en casa de su novio en Albuquerque. La familia toma cartas en el asunto para encontrarla, incluso recurriendo a la ayuda de un curandero.

Byron Edwards, de 27 años de edad, es encontrado muerto con signos de haber sido brutalmente apuñalado. A medida que los detectives investigan, se descubre una sola evidencia que cambia el curso de la investigación.

El mercado inmobiliario de Denver está complicado; cuando el estafador Ken Germain promete grandes ganancias y todos se emocionan, incluido su mano derecha, Colin Collea; luego, el sueño se acaba y los inversores ponen el grito en el cielo.
Un grupo de adolescentes de los suburbios invita a un hombre más grande a sumarse a su círculo. Pero el resultado es un asesinato tan terrible que consterna a toda la comunidad.

Elizabeth Chambers revela cómo Kate Ranta se encuentra atrapada en su matrimonio. Se siguen las pistas desde que el marido trata de salir de la cárcel, hasta la noche en que casi mata a tres generaciones de la familia de Kate.
Etta Jean Westbrook vive en un suburbio de Bryan, Texas. Su cuerpo es hallado en su casa y los detectives interrogan a sus seres queridos.

Nadie sabe de Lisa Stukey por semanas, y su cuerpo descompuesto es encontrado en su casa de Idaho Falls, Idaho. La policía descubre que Lisa fue golpeada hasta morir y comienza la búsqueda del culpable, quien tiene algún vínculo con la víctima.

In his second cinematic adventure, the mighty warrior Conan (Arnold Schwarzenegger) is tricked into working for the scheming Queen Taramis (Sarah Douglas). Along with finding a mystical horn, Conan and his allies, which include the fierce fighter, Zula (Grace Jones), and the wisecracking sorcerer, Akiro (Mako), must protect the beautiful young Princess Jehnna (Olivia d'Abo). With deception and danger at every turn, Conan has to use all of his power to defeat the evil foes that stand in his way.
Harry (Harry Anderson) learns Buddy (John Astin) neglected to tell his bride-to-be (Karen Morrow) that he was institutionalized for 20 years.

When Mason (Ice-T), homeless and living on the streets of Seattle, hears about a job as a hunting guide for a group of wealthy clients, he gladly signs on and is taken to a cabin in the middle of a Pacific Northwest forest. There he meets psychiatrist Doc Hawkins (Gary Busey), oil baron John Griffin (John C. McGinley) and Wall Street investor Derek Wolfe (F. Murray Abraham). The next morning, however, Mason is awakened to learn that he's the prey the men will be hunting.

In 1992 Bogotá, a little girl watches crime lord Don Luis and his henchman Marco murder her parents. Fifteen years later, the now-grown Cataleya, who is named for a Colombian orchid, works as a contract killer for her Chicago-based uncle. Leaving a lipstick drawing of her namesake on every victim, Cataleya carries out her assignments with efficiency and dreams of avenging her family.

Hondo Harrelson (Samuel L. Jackson) recruits Jim Street (Colin Farrell) to join an elite unit of the Los Angeles Police Department. Together they seek out more members, including tough Deke Kay (LL Cool J) and single mom Chris Sanchez (Michelle Rodriguez). The team's first big assignment is to escort crime boss Alex Montel (Olivier Martinez) to prison. It seems routine, but when Montel offers a huge reward to anyone who can break him free, criminals of various stripes step up for the prize.

After the death of the British prime minister, the world's most powerful leaders gather in London to pay their respects. Without warning, terrorists unleash a devastating attack that leaves the city in chaos and ruins. Secret Service agent Mike Banning (Gerard Butler) springs into action to bring U.S. President Benjamin Asher (Aaron Eckhart) to safety. When Asher falls into the hands of the sinister organization, it's up to Banning to save his commander in chief from a horrible fate.

Two years before the Civil War, Django (Jamie Foxx), a slave, finds himself accompanying an unorthodox German bounty hunter named Dr. King Schultz (Christoph Waltz) on a mission to capture the vicious Brittle brothers. Their mission successful, Schultz frees Django, and together they hunt the South's most-wanted criminals. Their travels take them to the infamous plantation of shady Calvin Candie (Leonardo DiCaprio), where Django's long-lost wife (Kerry Washington) is still a slave.
One man's brutal campaign for vengeance takes on national stakes after it's revealed he's a former operative of a powerful and clandestine organization known as Beekeepers.

Leaving a lipstick drawing of her namesake on every victim, Cataleya carries out her assignments with efficiency and dreams of avenging her family.

Hondo Harrelson (Samuel L. Jackson) recruits Jim Street (Colin Farrell) to join an elite unit of the Los Angeles Police Department. Together they seek out more members, including tough Deke Kay (LL Cool J) and single mom Chris Sanchez (Michelle Rodriguez). The team's first big assignment is to escort crime boss Alex Montel (Olivier Martinez) to prison. It seems routine, but when Montel offers a huge reward to anyone who can break him free, criminals of various stripes step up for the prize.

After the death of the British prime minister, the world's most powerful leaders gather in London to pay their respects. Without warning, terrorists unleash a devastating attack that leaves the city in chaos and ruins. Secret Service agent Mike Banning (Gerard Butler) springs into action to bring U.S. President Benjamin Asher (Aaron Eckhart) to safety. When Asher falls into the hands of the sinister organization, it's up to Banning to save his commander in chief from a horrible fate.

Two years before the Civil War, Django (Jamie Foxx), a slave, finds himself accompanying an unorthodox German bounty hunter named Dr. King Schultz (Christoph Waltz) on a mission to capture the vicious Brittle brothers. Their mission successful, Schultz frees Django, and together they hunt the South's most-wanted criminals. Their travels take them to the infamous plantation of shady Calvin Candie (Leonardo DiCaprio), where Django's long-lost wife (Kerry Washington) is still a slave.
One man's brutal campaign for vengeance takes on national stakes after it's revealed he's a former operative of a powerful and clandestine organization known as Beekeepers.

Tony helps prep a quirky, rare British TVR for sale and makes a play for one of the most elusive Camaros ever built, the legendary ZL1. When Tony is offered a rust-free '55 Chevy he knows it's too good of a deal to pass up.

Host Dennis Gage upholds his "honor the timeless classics" catchphrase in this series, as he travels across North America to visit prestigious auto shows and events, spotlighting everything from muscle cars to museum pieces. The handlebar mustachioed Gage takes viewers along for the ride and keeps it entertaining with his unique perspective and enthusiasm for all things automotive.
Stacey rolls in one of the show cars of the 1970s, the Mod Rod; after that, he shows how to properly disassemble the cab or body of your project and pre-fit some new components at the same time.
Sam begins the installation of a new Haltech system in his old Supra drag car.
Only the strongest competitors and machines compete in this one-of-a-kind off-road race that requires both speed and survival to finish this true test of man and machine.

After transferring to a Los Angeles high school, Sarah (Robin Tunney) finds that her telekinetic gift appeals to a group of three wannabe witches, who happen to be seeking a fourth member for their rituals. Bonnie (Neve Campbell), Rochelle (Rachel True) and Nancy (Fairuza Balk), like Sarah herself, all have troubled backgrounds, which combined with their nascent powers lead to dangerous consequences. When a minor spell causes a fellow student to lose her hair, the girls grow power-mad.

A teen gang in rural Oklahoma, the Greasers are perpetually at odds with the Socials, a rival group. When Greasers Ponyboy (C. Thomas Howell) and Johnny (Ralph Macchio) get into a brawl that ends in the death of a Social member, the boys are forced to go into hiding. Soon Ponyboy and Johnny, along with the intense Dallas (Matt Dillon) and their other Greaser buddies, must contend with the consequences of their violent lives. While some Greasers try to achieve redemption, others meet tragic ends.

Sarah, an undercover agent at a private intelligence firm, is hired to infiltrate the East, an ecoterrorism cell targeting companies that pollute the environment. Though one of the group's hardcore members is suspicious of her, Sarah manages to win over Benji, the East's leader. However -- even as Sarah tries to maintain her cover -- she gains more sympathy for the group's cause while, increasingly, becoming drawn to Benji.

Chief Warrant Officer Roy Miller and his team of inspectors are on a mission in 2003 to find Iraq's reported stockpiles of weapons of mass destruction. Traveling from one dangerous site to another, Miller and his team fail to find any chemical agents or other weapons. Instead, they discover an elaborate cover-up in which the most-elusive weapon is truth.

When U.S. Marine Gabriel Drummer (Shia LaBeouf) returns from Afghanistan, he finds the place he once called home is no better than the battlefields he fought on overseas. Accompanied by his best friend, a hard-nosed Marine whose natural instinct is to shoot first and ask questions later, Gabriel searches desperately for his estranged son and his wife, leading to a suspect who has vital information about their location.
A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative.

Harper retreats to the countryside to be alone in the wake of a tragedy, but her unease at the town's leering and uncannily similar men grows into a fully fledged nightmare as her arrival awakens something primal in the forest.

Capt. Nathan Algren (Tom Cruise) is an American military officer hired by the Emperor of Japan to train the country's first army in the art of modern warfare. As the government attempts to eradicate the ancient Samurai warrior class in preparation for more Westernized and trade-friendly policies, Algren finds himself unexpectedly affected by his encounters with the Samurai, which places him at the center of a struggle between two eras and two worlds.

Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators.

p.t: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
p.d: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race.

Dora es una joven periodista que busca a su hermana gemela desaparecida. Su investigación la lleva hasta Carol, una madre que necesita un cuidador para su hijo. Dora, haciéndose pasar por enfermera, acepta el trabajo y comienza a buscar pistas.

Un niño encuentra un fabricante de juguetes místico con historias emocionantes que contar: una sobre un duende que busca vengarse de una familia indefensa y otra sobre una muñeca que hace el mal a su frágil dueño.
El detective de Hong Kong, Bennie Black, se une a un jugador americano para capturar al jefe del crimen que mató a su compañero y secuestró a su sobrina.
Una tragedia en un misterioso lago atormenta a la familia Coyle, que debe enfrentarse a una aterradora entidad que quiere destruirlos para siempre.

Cuando una enfermedad desconocida aniquila a gran parte de la población mundial, un hombre con sangre única es aislado para su estudio. Temiendo por la seguridad de su esposa, rompe la cuarentena y se adentra en un mundo invadido por los infectados.

Crooked gamblers victimize delegates to a farm-equipment convention until Friday and Gannon step in.
Reed can't understand why his "shaggy dog" story isn't getting a hilarious response.
Hogan and his men must smuggle the crew of an American bomber out of camp.
Cartoon curator Bill and Toony the Tuna showcase classic cartoons featuring popular characters like Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and Tom and Jerry.
Beaver becomes overly chivalrous after reading Sir Walter Scott's "Ivanhoe."
Wally is cast as a dancing girl in a club play.
An elderly woman retains Perry when she feels her employer is about to be murdered, a crime for which she is later arrested.
A serial killer (Richard Gilliland) whose eventual target is Ben embarrasses him in court by leaving false clues.
A museum curator (Clu Gulager) plots Hawaii's most daring bank heist.
John-Boy returns home and tries to recall the details of his plane crash for a comrade's sister; Ike is arrested for draft evasion.
A woman and girl are with Matt as he pursues captives en route to Mexico.
A gang's plot to rob the Cartwrights' payroll and escape in their paddle-wheel steamboat threatens the family's timber operation.
Lucas' friends label him a tinhorn because of his gambling.
A blind banjo-playing wanderer strikes up an acquaintance with Mark.
