Claudia Winkleman, Rev Kate Bottley, Sara Barron and Ed Gamble join Rob Brydon, Lee Mack and David Mitchell.

Quiz show in which contestants are rewarded more if their answers are 'quite interesting'. In this extended episode, Stephen Fry asks unanswerable questions about hoaxes, with Sean Lock, David Mitchell, Danny Baker and Alan Davies.

Magnum's ex shows up at his home with a gunshot wound, wanting his help to find her missing CIA father whose life is in danger. Meanwhile, Magnum makes an earnest proposition to Higgins for her to become his private investigations partner.

Rob Beckett and Aisling Bea are joined by Katherine Ryan, Alex Brooker, Carol Vorderman, Ant Middleton, Tom Davis, Ella Eyre, Sara Pascoe, Nish Kumar, Jessica Knappett, Joe Wilkinson, and many other guests from the worlds of entertainment.
Dara Ó Briain and Hugh Dennis look back on the week's events with guests Tom Allen, Ed Gamble, Kerry Godliman, Rhys James and Sindhu Vee.
Jared sends Adrian and Leon into rough seas to recover a battered tugboat that could change their season.

A group of off-grid-living enthusiasts build a 300-sq-ft bungalow. It features variety of eco-friendly features, including a solar-powered water pump.

How do they transform rubber into chewing gum, how do they make fishhooks strong enough to catch a shark, and how are the models built at the world's largest Legoland?
Half of the star systems in our galaxy have two stars, possibly creating habitats for alien life. Here, binary stars fling entire worlds into space.

Adam teams up with actor Gary Oldman to build one of Hollywood's deadliest weapons: the ZF1 multi-artillery gun from sci-fi film, The Fifth Element. It is weapon so lethal that it features both a rocket launcher and a flamethrower.
Adam stages an epic food fight with his MythBusters pal, Tory Belleci. They build a rapid-fire weapon that turns hot dogs into destructive projectiles.
Treasure hunter Darrell Miklos dives the waters of Campeche, Mexico in search of shipwrecks first located by astronaut Gordon Cooper from space in 1963.
Darrell visits the Atocha, a valuable shipwreck Cooper recorded 50 years ago. Experts there send Darrell to an archive in Spain to hunt down an ancient manifest.
Interstellar space is the space between the universe's stars. New discoveries reveal that it's not empty and unremarkable as previously thought.
New discoveries lead scientists to question if the Big Bang really happened. They investigate if it was the start of many multiverses.
Dark matter and energy battle for the cosmos and the winner will determine the universe's fate. New discoveries may reveal which force will win.

Ant finds a donor 1950s chassis, so his ambitious Alfa 158 build can now begin in earnest. He also digs deep into his inspiration for this project.

Henry and Fuzz view an exquisite collection of military and civilian vehicles in Guildford. What will they sell to the drummer from a British rock band?

Die Gerichtsvollzieher Garry Ball und Matt Heighway glauben, dass sie schon alles gesehen haben. Doch dann sollen sie eine Zwangsvollstreckung bei einem Mann durchführen, der sie ignoriert und daraufhin in seinem eigenen Haus vor ihnen wegläuft.

Die Waschanlage läuft wieder rund, aber das ist bei der Jagd nach dem Edelmetall nur die halbe Miete. Nun muss sich herausstellen, ob das Schürfgut ausreichend Feingold für die Leihgebühr liefert. Außerdem steht Mat in Down Under unter Druck.

Ohne Diesel geht im Busch nichts voran, aber dann erreicht Mat die Nachricht, dass der Kraftstoff-Truck unterwegs ist. Der Goldgräber verlädt alle Fässer und Tanks auf Autos und Anhänger, um 6000 Liter über Stock und Stein ins Camp zu transportieren.

p.t: Fang des Lebens - Der gefährlichste Job Alaskas
p.d: Sig heißt seine Tochter willkommen und ein großes Leck im hydraulischen System der "Time Bandit" sorgt für gewaltige Probleme. Werden die Schiffsmechaniker das Problem rechtzeitig beheben können?

p.t: Fang des Lebens - Der gefährlichste Job Alaskas
p.d: Die Flotte ist sich nicht darüber einig, wo der Platz einer Frau auf einem Boot sein soll. Die Crew der "Northwestern" beginnt derweil mit dem Training der neuen Rekrutin: Sigs Tochter ist mit von der Partie.

In Thailand kann man Medikamente kaufen, für die man in Schweden ein Rezept benötigt. Das Gepäck eines Urlaubers, der aus Südostasien zurückkehrt, wird gründlich gecheckt. In Trelleborg entdecken Grenzschützer in einem Lieferwagen sehr viele Waffen.
In Arlanda wird Olivias Geduld auf die Probe gestellt, als ein Mann anfängt zu schreien.

Ein ungewöhnlicher Kunde im Pfandhaus Offenburg: Ein Mann möchte seinen Rasentrimmer beleihen, um schnell an Geld zu kommen. Für den Pfandleiher beginnt nun die knifflige Schätzung des Gartengeräts. Kann der Kunde auf einen guten Deal hoffen?

Außentermin in Sachsen: Zwei Schwestern legen in Weißig nach dem Tod ihrer Mutter Kisten voller Uhren, Ferngläser, Schmuck und Briefmarken bereit. Doch was sind die Erinnerungsstücke tatsächlich wert?

Erste Nachforschungen in Polen ergeben, dass im Boden etwas ganz Großes steckt. Damit ist aber noch nicht erwiesen, dass es sich um einen Panzer aus dem Zweiten Weltkrieg handelt. Michael Manousakis und seine Truppe sind trotzdem Feuer und Flamme.

Mithilfe einer selbst gebastelten Spezialkonstruktion und einem Bagger soll der Panzer in Polen geborgen werden. Zusammen mit Schweißgerät und Bolzen rücken zwei Dutzend Helfer im Sumpfgebiet an und schlagen dort ihre Zelte auf.

Die Sendung informiert über alle wichtigen Neuigkeiten aus der Welt. Die Zuschauer bekommen so einen Überblick über den aktuellen Stand verschiedenster Themen wie Gesellschaft, Kultur, Politik, Sport, Wirtschaft und Zeitgeschehen.

Auf der anderen Seite des Flusses streifen Wildtiere umher, die für Frank und Teal als Nahrung dienen könnten. Doch so weit können sie mit ihrem Bogen nicht schießen. Schwimmen ist auch keine Option, denn in dem Gewässer tummeln sich hungrige Krokodile. Um das Jagdgebiet zu erreichen, müsste das Duo eine Brücke bauen. Dafür erhielten sie obendrein 100 Punkte, mit denen sie im Ranking aufsteigen könnten. Für den nächsten Survival-Test sollen die Teams in Südafrika außerdem eine Fackel herstellen.

Twelve Naked and Afraid stars and rising stars take on a scorched, apocalyptic landscape where humans have tried -- and failed -- to survive. The veterans must repurpose the wreckage of a ghost town, cemetery, junkyard, and mine to make.
A musician and college student wants an off-the-grid treehouse compound with three structures, each serving living and sustainability, in the Arkansas woods.

A young couple sets out to create their dream treehouse retreat in Northern Georgia overlooking the breathtaking Blue Ridge Mountains. Although the build calls for a mile-long, uphill trek, they hope it will go smoothly.
Crab fishermen risk their lives as they battle Arctic weather, brutal waves and a ticking clock for big money in this modern-day gold rush on the Bering Sea.
Boyce takes a risk crossing a river to reach ground he hopes is rich, while Ben rappels down a cliff face. 68-year-old mining veteran John Belcik starts his descent into the Canyon.

Josh journeys into the heart of Mongolia in search of the fabled lost tomb of Genghis Khan. After encountering harsh weather and resistance from locals, can Josh enter Mongolia's 'Forbidden Zone' to locate the burial grounds?
Josh travels to Japan's remote Yonaguni Island to explore an underwater phenomenon described as Japan's Atlantis. Josh dives into the waters of the Pacific Rim to explore this remarkable site.

The Raneys attempt to rescue a family descended from rock'n'roll royalty by reclaiming their homestead from the jungle on Kauai. But when a dangerous flash flood strikes, the Raneys find themselves on the wrong side of the river and out of time.

The Cheals hit a massive pocket of plate-sized opal in their open cut mine. Lee and Roger attempt to find enough opal to purchase a water saving trommel. And brutal Outback temperatures cripple Cozza with severe heat stroke.
Rod, Sam and Ben try to find enough opal for Les's retirement before the end of the season. Cody escapes death in a deep shaft.
The Gold Devils have their sights set on a record-breaking total and a gold drought leads to one member of the Poseidon Crew questioning his future.
The Gold Devils move their multi-million-dollar operation in search of big gold. New team Vince, Bibi and Murray break ground on their dream lease.

After a giant suspension bridge begins to violently rock, it suddenly collapses, marking one of the most iconic engineering disasters of all time. Using the latest science, experts reveal what went so wrong at the Tacoma Narrows bridge.

p.t: In the Eye of the Storm
p.d: Hundreds of people in Nebraska and Iowa capture videos of their terrifying escapes as a powerful derecho superstorm tears through the region.

Heather and Phil continue their investigation of haunted Savannah, Georgia. Their quest takes them deep into the wilderness. There, they discover a place of terrible tragedy. Many locals believe this tragedy has led to powerful paranormal activity.
A hunter from Louisiana meets a California surfer girl on a deserted island of the Philippines. With very little water to tap into, dehydration soon sets in.

Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.

Robert Jordan is the idealist who joins the Republicans and is charged with blowing up a strategically important bridge. Among the group aiding him are Maria, with whom he falls in love, Pablo, the drunken leader of the group, and his wife Pilar, who eventually takes charge.

As a young student, J.R.R. Tolkien finds love, friendship and artistic inspiration among a group of fellow outcasts. Their brotherhood soon strengthens as Tolkien weathers the storm of a tumultuous courtship with Edith Bratt and the outbreak of World War I. These early life experiences later inspire the budding author to write the classic fantasy novels The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings.
An Army outpost doctor clashes with his commander when he attempts to treat a band of malaria-stricken Indians.

Automotive designer Carroll Shelby and race car driver Ken Miles build a revolutionary vehicle for the Ford Motor Co. to compete against the race cars of Enzo Ferrari at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in France in 1966.

William Wallace is the medieval Scottish patriot who is spurred into revolt against the English when the love of his life is slaughtered. Leading his army into battles that become a war, his advance into England threatens King Edward I's throne before he is captured and executed, but not before becoming a symbol for a free Scotland.

Prince Amleth is on the verge of becoming a man when his father is brutally murdered by his uncle, who kidnaps the boy's mother. Two decades later, Amleth is now a Viking who's on a mission to save his mother, kill his uncle and avenge his father.
Tazeen is falsely accused of theft, and Mohtashim, a wealthy man, marries her to offer protection. However, Rayan secretly loves Tazeen and sets out to get revenge.

The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race.
A New York City lawyer returning to her small town gets caught in the middle of a murder case.
An uplifting round-up of good news stories from the UK and around the world.

While investigating the shooting of a New York City cab driver, Carrie uncovers a secret that may have led to the man's murder.

Alexis enlists Castle's help to prove that a death row inmate was wrongly convicted. With only 72 hours left before his execution, they urgently investigate the original murder.
Dr Mark Sloan begins watching his neighbours through binoculars and becomes convinced that one of them is a murderer.
Dr Sloan, stuck at home with a broken leg, notices a neighbour whom he knows to be abusive going out to sea to dispose of something. He suspects it to be the body of the man's wife.

An outdoor charity rock concert organised to save Maine Woods from developers is threatened when a singer is murdered by electrocution during a rehearsal. Can Jessica and Sheriff Metzger catch the killer and salvage the concert?

A young publishing house editor becomes convinced that a new manuscript chronicles an unsolved kidnapping ordeal she endured 11 years earlier, but when she accuses the author of abducting her, he is later found dead in his hotel suite.
When a relationship therapist is murdered, it appears that her access to the secrets of her powerful clients led to her death. But a rare object found in her possession complicates the case.
A boy racer is shot while delivering a car to a diplomat, prompting Carrie to explore whether he was the target or a victim of mistaken identity.

Jesus Moreno enters witness protection in order to testify against a mob boss, but his teenage daughter Olivia is not pleased about the situation and starts causing problems. Meanwhile, Mary and Raphael talk about their relationship.
A wedding photographer gets involved in the investigation after a groom is fatally shot during his first dance.

p.d: Harold Shipman was a much-loved doctor. Millions watched the GP speaking on TV discussing the benefits of care, not knowing he'd already killed dozens of patients.
The bond between twin brothers proves to be stronger than the one between a husband and wife; true love takes a tragic, deadly turn.
Manjit and Mukhtiar get married and set up a home together in suburbia. But fierce arguments soon turn their dreams into a nightmare.
Lost souls Frank and Angelina Rodriguez appear to have finally found true love. Then, a sudden death leads investigators to uncover a shocking tale.
Cynthia Smith and David Mueller's happy marriage is rocked by a tragic illness. When David dies, detectives uncover a sinister plot.

p.t: Who the Hell Did I Marry?
p.d: When Melanie marries James Addie, she believes she's found the perfect husband, unaware he will lead a double life one day. As the days count down to his second wedding, James' secret is in danger of being exposed, and soon someone will die.

p.t: Who the Hell Did I Marry?
p.d: Sean Scott marries his high school sweetheart, Wendi Ellis. Things soon turn sour as Wendi racks up bizarre and destructive offences. In the final conflict, Sean must choose between his family's survival and his sworn vow.
Dallas Police discover a serial killer targeting vulnerable retirees.

Carla Lewis gives her husband John money to open a medical marijuana store that sells pain relief products; spiralling costs, rumours of illegal activities and a string of infidelities eclipse the good intentions and sow the seeds for murder.

Jeffrey and Jeannine Glanda appear to have it all, the house, the children and the lifestyle; when half of the partnership craves control more than love, it sets in motion a deadly plot ending with a suspicious car accident and a watery grave.

James Bond adventure in which 007 relinquishes his licence to kill, disobeys his orders and goes on a mission of revenge when his best friend's wife is killed by a drug baron. A beautiful CIA pilot flies him to Sanchez's South American headquarters where, disguised as a hit man, Bond is hired by the villainous drug dealer.
Dawson moves forward with a news piece about his father's star player, Jack, and Jen tries to remove herself as head cheerleader.
An old family friend appeals to Piper, Phoebe and Prue to stop a demon who steals the skin from corpses, and Piper doesn't want to be a witch any more.
Lee joins Stephen Mulhern for his turn to open the red boxes in the hope of leaving the Banker out of pocket. Will he be able to keep the big reds in the game to attract some equally big offers?
Teachers Elton and Dan, detectives Vicky and Jenny and mother and son Sharon and Dale compete.
Graham Norton hosts as curriculum and quality manager Tana, train conductor Mikey, and operations manager Charlotte go head-to-head with the iconic Wheel for a chance to win 50,000 pounds.
Sparks fly as the group gather for Chloe's fundraiser. Amber tells Girlband about the long video call she had with Dan where they spoke about their relationship.

Jacqueline's peace offering at Karen's Love Lagoon falls flat. The ladies head to Panama where Wendy sets up some choice room pairings. During a dinner, the group has words with Mia about her behaviour.

p.t: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
p.d: Sutton gets what she needs from her mum; Bozoma discusses her fears about having a child; Dorit tries to lift her spirits by hosting a July 4 BBQ; after a teary storm out, Kyle and Garcelle are forced to pick sides.

Stephen Mulhern hosts a celebrity special of the classic game show with Gyles Brandreth, Cliff Parisi and Perri Shakes-Drayton all trying to 'say what they see' as they guess well-known phrases for the chance to win £50,000 for their chosen charity.
Graham Norton invites barrister Daniel, site manager Lorraine, and software sales rep Nicole to take on the iconic Wheel and tackle a series of puzzles for a shot at winning 50,000 pounds.
Lee Mack returns as 100 more contestants try and make it all the way to the 1% question and win up to £100,000. Will anyone succeed?

A cast of carefully selected housemates from all walks of life take up residence in the world's most famous reality TV home for up to six weeks, with cameras capturing their every move and the nation following every twist and turn.
Meg learns that the cool kids plan to prank Chris. Peter and the gang get jealous when Cleveland starts hanging out with Jerome.
When Mayor West raises the drinking age to 50, Brian -- thanks to dog years -- is the only one old enough to buy alcohol for Peter.
Francine regrets deciding to teach Roger the value of hard work and Steve interviews Stan for a school project.
When a brutal murder disturbs the tranquillity of an ancient Oxford college, Morse discovers that he has unwittingly provided all the suspects with a watertight alibi.
Bellamy tries to win Miller's approval by going it alone, and Vernon's prospects look bleak when the tax-man comes to town.

Rob is forced to re-evaluate a new romance when his girlfriend's wild party ends in tragedy. David is delighted when a face from the past arrives in Aidensfield, but Rosie and Bernie are not convinced that the newcomer's intentions are all they might be.
Serious allegations are made against members of staff at The Royal, and there is more trouble when a suspected drunk driver is brought in after a road accident.

It's Du Plessis' 60th birthday, but he's been diagnosed with angina and doesn't feel like celebrating. Danny tries to keep him active by involving him in his lion breeding programme, but their attempt to inseminate a lioness ends in tragedy.

Emmerdale is one of Britain's best-loved and highly viewed long-running drama soaps - set in the heart of the beautiful countryside of the Yorkshire Dales, this realistic and down-to-earth drama superbly chronicles the joys and the heartbreaks of a tightly knit countryside community.

Emmerdale is one of Britain's best-loved and highly viewed long-running drama soaps - set in the heart of the beautiful countryside of the Yorkshire Dales, this realistic and down-to-earth drama superbly chronicles the joys and the heartbreaks of a tightly knit countryside community.
David claims to be a new man after his time away and remains calm as he learns of Joe's arrangements. Peter's jealousy of Michelle's friendship with Luke threatens his sobriety.
Tempers fray as the Platts celebrate Easter, and amid the chaos David offers Tina a gift. Kevin challenges Tyrone to a race and Ken considers attending Martha's performance.
Ashfordly station is targeted by crooks stealing freight wagons with a rogue locomotive. Peggy prepares to rake in the profits when she fixes the local bowls tournament.

Two small girls provide crucial information when they stumble across a sinister scam whilst playing on the moors. Peggy's poker-playing antics force Blaketon to take drastic action. Could a night out lead to love for Rob?

Martin rubs up against the new herbalist and Penhale, Louisa and James are all interested in Janice's new pedicure fish. Martin's ex-flame invites him to speak as keynote speaker at Imperial College, and Ruth is back from Mexico with more than maracas.

Martin is suspicious and Louisa is shocked with the unannounced return of her father. Ruth helps Martin with his blood phobia when she discovers his predicament, and an unexpected caravan squatter thwarts Bert's dreams of making a quick buck.

With the wedding approaching there is excitement in the air. Spanish flu reaches Downton and a desperate Thomas looks for a way to re-establish himself. Ethel faces a dilemma when the Bryants return with a heartbreaking proposition. A decisive Anna forces Bates to think about their future.
The discovery of slaves turns a murder inquiry into a huge, multi-agency investigation, which threatens to topple Gill. But Scott and Bailey are determined to protect Gill's prodigious reputation.

David claims to be a new man after his time away and remains calm as he learns of Joe's arrangements. Peter's jealousy of Michelle's friendship with Luke threatens his sobriety.
Tempers fray as the Platts celebrate Easter, and amid the chaos David offers Tina a gift. Kevin challenges Tyrone to a race and Ken considers attending Martha's performance.
Ashfordly station is targeted by crooks stealing freight wagons with a rogue locomotive. Peggy prepares to rake in the profits when she fixes the local bowls tournament.

Call centre manager Stephen Robinson asks his guests to arrive dressed appropriately for his pink and black theme, and his evening starts on a high, with his spicy butternut squash soup going down a treat, but things soon turn with the main course.

Beef farmer Alison Davies is serving Dyfed the cow, from her Hereford herd, as part of her menu. Alison decides to show her guests around the farm, but Stephen worries he'll get poo on his new espadrilles.
It is day four in Warrington and tonight's host is science teacher Emma Hoyle, who's hoping that her scientific approach to planning and attention to detail will help her take the top prize.

Linda Weaver puts on a fancy dress party with a multicultural theme on the final night in Warrington, but will this, along with her eclectic menu and her bagpipe playing skills, be enough to win the week?
This competition kicks off at Nateby Inn in Cumbria, where landlady Gaynor Walker is ready with a warm welcome. A trip to Gaynor's local brewery turns out to be a barrel of laughs.

The second visit of the week is to Ravensden, Bedfordshire, where owners Graham and Julia Ashley run Outfields Farm B&B. The hosts treat their guests to an adrenaline-fuelled afternoon at an indoor skydiving centre.

The third visit of the week is to At Home in Chiswick, London, where artist Bob Osborne takes a laid-back approach to running his B&B. Guests are pleasantly surprised by their first impression of Bob's communal living space-cum-mini art gallery.
The final visit of the week is to Chard, Somerset, where Andrew and Clare Ashmore own the Ammonite Lodge guesthouse.
It's time for the B&B-ers to face the music, as they come together for one last time to find out what they've been paid and confront their critics, face to face.

Series in which Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove nose around people's sheds and garages in search of automotive bargains. Today, the pair are in Somerset where they discover an amazing collection of Norton motorbikes, Italian mopeds and French go-karts. Moving on to Hertfordshire, they find vintage cars, obscure tractors and rare British bikes from the 1950s. Everything is going well, but when the haggling starts, things don't turn out quite how anyone expected.

Today the Shed and Buried boys are moving on to Hertfordshire, where they find vintage cars, obscure tractors and rare British bikes from the 1950s. It's all going well, but when the haggling starts, things don't turn out quite how anyone expected.

Series in which Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove nose around people's sheds and garages in search of automotive bargains. Today, the pair are in the Cotswolds where they discover sheds full of stationary engines, obscure agricultural implements and some very surprising collections of memorabilia. Moving on up to Sussex, they go behind the scenes at one of Britain's most famous bike shops, and find in its dark corners and dusty attics, two extraordinary hidden gems.

In this episode, Henry and Sam are uncovering vintage treasures in West Sussex. They go behind the scenes at one of Britain's most famous bike shops, and in its dark corners and dusty attics find two extraordinary hidden gems.

p.t: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
p.d: Simon O'Brien and Max McMurdo head for Crewe to meet rock and roller Billy, who lives in a house that is frozen in time in the 1950s.
Angus helps an army veteran shift a mountain of Lego to raise money for his daughter, and a trip to London unearths exquisite Victorian jewellery.

Angus helps a widow sell three generations of memories, including wartime treasures and a rare photo of magician Houdini, while a couple in Essex sell their sci-fi stash to fund a wedding 26 years in the making.

Captain Izzie Balmer and First Mate Charlie Ross are sailing to the Isle of Wight for their final leg of this Road Trip. Charlie rips his trousers while on horseback, and Izzie ditches the classic car in favour of a speedboat.
Angus helps clear a family home, packed with museum pieces. And a retired teacher parts with Sheffield steel, French glass and a seafarer's desk.
Three highly sentimental heirlooms are thrown a lifeline, including an old fishing reel and a quirky leather footstool shaped like a pig.

A 1960s record player and a flamboyant pair of 1970s boots are given a new lease of life. Plus, a painting by artist Helene de Beauvoir, sister of French philosopher Simone de Beauvoir, is lovingly restored.

Alex looks for a black gown fit for Morticia Addams and Lucille Ball; Prashanthi needs a dress ASAP, but her appointment is in trouble when her future brother-in-law asks to see a topless dress; Jen's dress might not fit.

Groundbreaking forensic technology is used to track down the killer of an 87-year-old woman who was brutally murdered in her own home. Male domestic abuse victim Ian McNicholl tells the story of his suffering at the hands of his ex-girlfriend.
Phillip Fraser's daughter talks about the murderer, who killed his ex-wife in 1997, before stabbing another former partner to death while out on licence.

p.t: On the Case With Paula Zahn
p.d: Police trace a trail of blood in an attempt to catch a cold and calculating killer.

In May 2013, 36-year-old Army veteran Maribel Ramos disappears from her Orange, California flat without a trace. Suspecting foul play, investigators devise a unique surveillance strategy to track her down and uncover some disturbing evidence.
When Leesa Nascimento is killed by a shot in the head, a recently sacked co-worker, is traced after evidence is found that ties him to the murder.
Stephanie is a gifted stage performer and much-loved teacher; behind closed doors, resentment and envy fester in her marriage, leading to a shocking 911 call.
Ramon Sosa is a father of three who runs a successful boxing gym in Texas; he feels like the luckiest man alive until someone marks him for murder.

Teenager Cindy Taylor's world is shattered by the sudden death of her father, while police say he died of a heart attack, Taylor will discover the cause of her father's death is just one of the deadly secrets her mother had been hiding from her.
A woman's life is in the balance after she escapes years of coercive control and domestic abuse. And the tragic case of 16-year-old Thomas Edwards, who was killed following a hit-and-run accident.
Christian Aguilar mysteriously vanishes from his university campus. Police are stumped, until some CCTV footage leads the case in a shocking new direction.
In 2014, Kimberly Robertson's battered body is found on a pavement after a date with her boyfriend. Can CCTV footage help detectives identify her killer?
When Aziza Murphy ends a relationship with a man she meets online, he launches a relentless stalking campaign that takes her job, safety and peace.
Elizabeth investigates the troubling case of Kate Ranta, a military wife who found herself in an abusive relationship and battling all the systems that protect abusers.
In 2012, local DJ Ervin Holton is shot dead on his friend's porch. With no witnesses, police turn to the security cameras opposite for evidence.
Misunderstood, unpredictable, deadly. Get up close with the hippo as rival males clash, crushing jaws snap, and new life emerges beneath the water's surface.

In the forests of Southern India, the relentless heat of the summer brings challenges for Asian elephants, who need to drink every day. As the water starts to disappear around her, a wise old matriarch called Anura decides it is time to lead her family on the yearly migration to ensure their survival. Her journey is made all the more important as there is a new addition to the herd, her three-month-old grandson Navin.

Heading into surgery with Mara the koala, who needs a life-saving tooth operation, then assessing an injured sugar glider with vet Tim. Cheering as rescue officer Elise pulls a flying fox out of a gutter.
Woolly monkey Oriana's health check causes concern, the chimps have a bust-up and the guenon family try out a new tree in their enclosure.
A video of a sick male marmoset results in an urgent rescue mission. It may be too late to save the male, but there's hope yet for a female at the same address.
Dive into the crystal clear waters of Cozumel, a lush Caribbean paradise just off the coast of Mexico that hides the largest subterranean underwater cave system in the world.
When a Mountie saves a beaver, Hope helps the most Canadian wildlife rescue ever reach a happy ending.

p.t: Mujer, casos de la vida real: Edición especial
p.d: Una edición especial sobre el programa de historias verdaderas enviadas por el público a la actriz Silvia Pinal. Temas de interés general que son censurados por la sociedad.

La doctora Ana María Polo interviene en batallas legales que afectan a los latinos. Como en una corte, las partes presentan testigos y evidencias para que ella emita su decisión. Además, expertos contribuyen con sus conocimientos.
Una condena injusta cambia la vida de Alejandro Gaitán y lo separa de la mujer que ama, Mariana Zambrano. En prisión, se convierte en otra persona y regresa, 17 años más tarde, para vengarse.
Un incendio coarta los sueños de Rocío, una joven estudiante con un novio cariñoso, Gabino, ya que pierde su casa, su dinero, su futuro y su sueño.
Franco abandona su pasión por la música para darle una estabilidad a su familia. No obstante, harto de su rutina, decide seguir con sus sueños, pero su familia no lo toma muy bien.

A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.

La historia de Yolanda, una hermosa e inteligente reclusa, quien en la cárcel se convierte en la amante de uno de los narcotraficantes más importante del país, Benedictino García, conocido como "El Centauro". Esta relación le da a Yolanda mucho poder, pero también es su pesadilla cuando sale en libertad.
Una condena injusta cambia la vida de Alejandro Gaitán y lo separa de la mujer que ama, Mariana Zambrano. En prisión, se convierte en otra persona y regresa, 17 años más tarde, para vengarse.
Patricia y su hermano sufrieron mucho en su infancia, y ya no lo pueden soportar.

Juan Carlos Caballero, un ejecutivo importante de una empresa turística, que solía ser mujeriego, cae en las redes del amor y dos sucesos contrarios lo obligan a huir. Luego, él regresa asumiendo la personalidad de una mujer, Eva, con el fin de conquistar a la mujer que ama, Helena Moreno, una madre soltera, trabajadora y visionaria y de desenmascarar a los culpables causantes de su huida, quienes lo desacreditaron injustamente, al ser acusado de un fraude financiero y de haberle robado el proyecto turístico a Helena. En su nueva personalidad, él está cerca de Helena pero a la vez nunca ha estado tan lejos, las situaciones difíciles que se le presentan al tener que imitar al género opuesto no son tan complicadas como el evitar que sus sentimientos por Helena sean tan evidentes que lo delaten. Una adaptación de la telenovela colombiana "En los Tacones de Eva".

Doña Florinda hace unos churros exquisitos y decide venderlos con la ayuda de don Ramón.
En ocasión de una de las reiteradas visitas del profesor Jirafales, doña Florinda aprovecha para hacerle sus famosos churros. Sin embargo, misteriosamente, desaparecen de la mesa.
Un equipo violento está atacando camiones repartidores de productos farmacéuticos y robando drogas, pero va más allá del dinero. El caso pone a prueba la relación entre Upton y Ruzek.

El Dr. Choi necesita que April le ayude a averiguar el verdadero motivo por el que un vecino fue acuchillado. Noah yerra en el diagnóstico de un paciente. El padre desaparecido de la Dra. Reese llega a la consulta de Charles sin que ella lo sepa.

Manning y Choi asisten a una madre que da a luz bajo circunstancias excepcionalmente difíciles. Rhodes y Bekker difieren sobre cuál es el mejor tratamiento para un niño afectado por una enfermedad crónica. Goodwin y Maggie tienen problemas legales.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
p.d: Cuando dos ataques de francotiradores al DPNY relacionan el pasado del detective Tutuola como oficial de narcóticos, él busca a un compañero para descubrir el motivo; teniente Alexandra Eames ayuda en la investigación de UVE.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
p.d: La investigación de cómo una mujer comatosa terminó en un río cerca de la casa del alcalde revela el lado salvaje e insospechado de la víctima.

El Dr. Halstead y el Dr. Manning están en desacuerdo con el cuidado de un hombre en estado vegetativo. El Dr. Rhodes se antepone al Dr. Bekker para colocar a su paciente primero en la lista de trasplantes. Una mujer en la sala de espera se duerme.

Tras el secuestro de un bebé, Goodwin les pide ayuda al Dr. Charles y a la Dra. Reese para encontrar al sospechoso. El Dr. Rhodes debe hallar la forma de entrar a la sala de operaciones y ayudar en una cirugía a corazón abierto.
Una pareja está en peligro cuando se incendia su casa. Dawson y Casey son obligados a separarse. El festival de Chicago le da a Molly la oportunidad de lucirse.

Dos miembros de la estación de bomberos desaparecen después de una llamada rutinaria. Casey y Dawson luchan por equilibrar su vida personal y profesional. Boden y Donna descubren que su bebé tiene posibles complicaciones.
Un incendio en una unidad de almacenamiento parece tener conexión con otro incendio que le quitó la vida a Shay. El capellán Orlovsky sufre un accidente de tránsito.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
p.d: Benson y Carisi llevan a juicio a un jefe del crimen. Fin intenta ayudar a una mujer que fue drogada y dada por muerta. Velasco toma medidas drásticas para obtener información de un testigo.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
p.d: Un accidente automovilístico lleva a los detectives a buscar a un chofer de ambulancia que ataca a las personas que tiene a su cargo. Fin le da al detective Bruno un tour por la UVE de Manhattan.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
p.d: Un preso recién liberado busca al agente que lo detuvo, Fin Tutuola. Carisi intenta conseguir una orden de detención sin una identificación positiva del sospechoso.
La investigación del asesinato del novio de Burgess amenaza con revelar un secreto oscuro desconocido para ella. La motivación real del asesinato revela mucho más que una verdad inquietante.
Un equipo violento está atacando camiones repartidores de productos farmacéuticos y robando drogas, pero va más allá del dinero. El caso pone a prueba la relación entre Upton y Ruzek.
La ciudad de Nueva York se llena de balas cuando John Wick, un ex asesino a sueldo, enfrenta a los mafiosos rusos que destruyeron todo aquello que él amaba y pusieron precio a su cabeza.

Benoit Blanc, un detective implacable, investiga la muerte de un anciano escritor de novelas policíacas en la mansión del difunto. Benoit tendrá que sortear las trampas y mentiras que la excéntrica familia y los sirvientes del novelista han urdido.
Descubra el mundo apasionado y desconocido del rodaje y todos los secretos que no se muestran en la televisión.

Cuando los tesoros más grandes del mundo, incluido el diamante de la Pantera Rosa, son robados, solamente un hombre puede resolver el misterio: Clouseau. Junto con su compañero Ponton y un equipo de detectives internacionales, el inepto detective debe atrapar al ladrón y recuperar los artefactos, sin provocar muchos daños colaterales en el proceso.

Un cuidador muy querido del zoológico de Franklin Park decide que la única forma de conseguir novia es buscarse una carrera más glamurosa. Los animales le revelan su capacidad secreta para hablar y se ofrecen a enseñarle cómo conquistar a una mujer.
Dos estudiantes se dan cuenta de que deberían haber estudiado menos, por lo que tratan de recuperar los cuatro años de diversión perdidos en una alocada noche.

Dos días antes de su boda, Doug y tres amigos viajan a Las Vegas para una fiesta inolvidable y salvaje. De hecho, cuando los tres acompañantes despiertan la mañana siguiente, no recuerdan nada ni encuentran a Doug. Con poco tiempo por delante, los tres amigos intentan recordar sus pasos y encontrar a Doug para que regrese a Los Ángeles para su boda.
Con la esperanza de evitar el caos que marcó su despedida de soltero en Las Vegas, Stu opta por lo que él cree que será una celebración tranquila en Tailandia.
Phil, Stu y Doug llevan a Alan a un viaje por carretera para ayudarlo a superar una crisis personal. Mientras tanto, el Sr. Chow sale de prisión y se prepara para desatar un caos.
Extrañas luces aparecen sobre Los Ángeles y anuncian la llegada de una fuerza extraterrestre maligna que pretende engullir a toda la población terrestre.

Arthur se ve obligado a sacar de prisión a su hermanastro, Orm, para que lo ayude a detener a Kane, quien ha atacado Atlantis tras encontrar un tridente negro que lo posee y le da la fuerza para vengar la muerte de su padre.
Después de la muerte de sus padres, el joven heredero Bruce Wayne se convierte en un vengador enmascarado que lucha contra las fuerzas del mal en Ciudad Gótica.

Luego de Navidad, una joven pareja es hallada asesinada en su casa de Florida. Los vecinos creen que la pareja ha estado poco tiempo en el lugar como para tener un enemigo mortal. La policía revela detalles personales.

Durante el receso de primavera, un estudiante desaparece después de cruzar la frontera con México en Brownsville, Texas. La investigación lleva a un culto que practica la brujería y es dirigido por un exmodelo y una porrista.
La hija de una de las mujeres más peligrosas de Gran Bretaña revela cómo la brutal masacre de su madre, cuyas tres víctimas se produjeron en marzo de 2013, afectó a su propia vida.

Un agente de policía jubilado aparece muerto a tiros en un vagón del metro en Brooklyn. Los agentes descubren que su muerte está relacionada con otros dos tiroteos, aparentemente aleatorios ocurridos en las trece horas anteriores.

East Cleveland queda destrozado cuando se encuentran los cuerpos de 11 mujeres asesinadas en la casa de los horrores. A medida que los crímenes se hacen públicos, la hermana del asesino enfrenta amenazas de muerte.

p.t: Matthew Perry: Una tragedia de Hollywood
p.d: La historia detrás de la muerte de Matthew Perry y los cargos penales contra cinco personas, entre ellas dos médicos y una mujer conocida como "la reina de la ketamina de Hollywood".
Cuando la policía deja de investigar la desaparición de una familia de ateos, un intrépido periodista entra en acción.

Un comerciante y padre de cuatro hijos es asesinado a tiros en su casa mientras su familia está atada en un armario. La policía indaga en vínculos con la mafia y un compañero de trabajo desaparecido, hasta que se revela un complot años después.

Una madre joven es encontrada muerta en un campo después de una noche de fiesta, luego la policía revisa el video de seguridad para seguir los pasos del sospechoso. El descubrimiento de una segunda escena de crimen conduce a un arresto.
Una pareja desesperada secuestra a un empresario rico que los lleva al asesinato.
Dos amantes se embarcan en una misión mortal encargada por un profeta iluminado, que quiere que prueben su devoción el uno por el otro y ambos por el culto.
Un joven padre desaparecido vuelve a su casa en Utah y confiesa que ha tenido una aventura, pero cuando, poco tiempo después, vuelve a desaparecer, algo más siniestro parece estar en juego.
Una mujer de Colorado desaparece poco después de mudarse con un grupo de amigos. Una investigación revela que sucedía mucho más dentro de la casa de lo que nadie se había dado cuenta.
Cathy encuentra el valor para denunciar los abusos físicos, mentales y emocionales a los que la sometió su expareja, Peter Tobin, tras descubrir los asesinatos cometidos por este.
Pam no tiene ni idea de que está compartiendo cama con el desconocido asesino apodado "El Estrangulador de Suffolk", mientras aterroriza a una comunidad de Ipswich.
El equipo investiga el asesinato de un informante profesional después de que fue encontrado muerto afuera de una fábrica abandonada en Red Hook.

El asesino en serie, Byron May, es puesto en libertad y se instala en secreto en la residencia de otra persona. Sus métodos se parecen a los del encarcelado "Destripador de Eastside", lo que genera dudas sobre una posible condena errónea.

Después de cuidar a su esposo moribundo durante varios meses, una mujer colapsa tras un paro respiratorio. Mientras el hombre mejora misteriosamente, la condición de la mujer empeora y el equipo se ve obligado a tomar una complicada decisión.

Cameron pide a House que acepte el caso de un ambientalista que se desmayó durante una protesta y comienza a mostrar una serie de síntomas inexplicables. House acepta, pero obliga a Cameron a tomar el mando de la situación.

El hemisferio izquierdo y derecho de un paciente funcionan de forma independiente, y crean dos personalidades distintas que complican la búsqueda de un diagnóstico. House decide internarse en un hospital psiquiátrico a causa de las alucinaciones.

House inicia su desintoxicación con la esperanza de detener las alucinaciones. El Dr. Nolan es el encargado de escribir la carta de recomendación para habilitar la licencia de House, pero no lo hará hasta estar seguro de sus verdaderas intenciones.

Cuando un agente de seguridad diplomática fuera de servicio recibe un disparo mortal en la ciudad de Nueva York al intentar detener a alguien, el equipo investiga si existe una conexión con el tiempo que trabajó en Croacia.
El tiroteo de un oficial penitenciario federal lleva al equipo a un ex infante de marina que se ha rebelado.
Maggie llama a Remy para que ayude a Scola en su misión encubierta para encontrar a los terroristas que se cree son responsables del inminente ataque en Nueva York.

El equipo trabaja para dar caza al francotirador responsable de la muerte de un estadounidense durante un atentado dirigido contra un laboratorio biomédico en Bélgica. Jaeger se enfrenta a su jefe en Europol por su lealtad al equipo.

El hijo de 19 años de un multimillonario estadounidense es encontrado inconsciente en su apartamento, mientras el equipo trabaja para determinar si hubo al sucio escondido, se dan cuenta de que también hay un grupo oscuro en el caso.

El equipo investiga a un hombre que perdió el vuelo de un avión privado derribado fuera de un pequeño pueblo de Polonia en el que viajaban ciudadanos estadounidenses. Forrester se siente disconforme cuando recibe información de su madre.
Don Gil contrata a Veneno, una leyenda en declive, como nuevo entrenador de Las Navajas para ayudarles a ganar.
Troy toma una decisión arriesgada mientras evade a la policía, que sabe que está ocultando información clave.
El comportamiento errático de Stan alimenta las sospechas cuando surge una nueva prueba condenatoria en la desaparición de Joy.
Benito se prepara para hacer un casting y personificar a un famoso boxeador. Luis descubre que hay una fuga de gas. ¿Germán logrará componerla o la convertirá en una gran fuga?

Don Clemente decide que Diana se case el mismo día del bautizo del bebé.

La historia de seis parejas que tienen dificultades en sus matrimonios y los problemas que tienen que enfrentar día a día; las esposas que luchan por sacar adelante el hogar tratando de equilibrar su vida hogareña con sus trabajos.
A los 17 años, Rina queda viuda y millonaria. Su cuñada Rafaela trama un plan para casarla con su hijo Carlos Augusto para despojarla de su fortuna.
Paula decide dejar a Rogelio después de enterarse de su relación con Erika, y él no puede soportar el abandono de su esposa ni la pérdida de su hija.
Un juez contrata a una joven humilde para que trabaje como tutora de su hijo rebelde y ella se gana el afecto de ambos.

Desesperada por encontrar empleo, una chica nada atractiva, se coloca como secretaria en la compañía Conceptos. Lety se enamora perdidamente de su jefe, pero ignora las razones por las cuales Fernando intenta seducirla y engañar a su bella prometida.
Un hombre de poder, casado con una joven, oculta secretos que camuflan un presente aparentemente perfecto.

Clara no puede entenderse con Juan, por lo cual piensa que es mejor decirse adiós. Jero se emborracha y termina durmiendo con Lina, la hija de su nana, que siempre ha estado enamorada de él. Jero le dice a Juan que quiere vender su parte del rancho.

Omar necesita un colchón para poder dormir, pero sus padres prefieren gastar en otras cosas que en el bienestar de su hijo y sus estudios. Sin embargo, don Meli, su vecino, podría cambiar la vida de Omar.
Los vecinos se quedan sin agua porque Germán no pagó el servicio. Además, tienen que arreglar algunas fugas de agua, pero Germán los convence de que mejor se compren una mesa de tenis de mesa.
La familia P. Luche festeja el Día de las Madres de una manera muy particular. Ludovico intenta componer el baño, pero un plomero muy guapo lo ayudará.

Los guardas intentan encontrar un hogar recubierto para una nutria.

El avión de papel de Leo se choca con un colugo y el equipo debe emprender la búsqueda de la madre del animal.
Los pequeños guardabosques parten para traer a casa a una civeta de las palmeras común, después de que roba la comida de Hero.
